147000.description:
College student-cum-pianist Su-yeon goes into a destructive spiral after he messes up his piano performance. And he's decided getting into bed with strangers is the best way to cope with his anxiety. When he's sleeping with someone, it's like all his troubles just melt away—like he's underwater. During one of his meltdowns, he ends up sleeping with Hae-su, a student-athlete. Except Su-yeon has no memory of the incident. Hae-su remembers it all however, and when the two end up working together on a group project, he is determined to break down Su-yeon's walls. Hesitant at first, Su-yeon gradually discovers that there's more to life than just being surrounded by shades of blue. Will Hae-su be able to pull Su-yeon from the water he's submerged himself in or will the current be too strong to...resist?

(Source: Lezhin US)

In Aeria, a place where people from various worlds are summoned, the weak are destined to die. Lee Sungmin, a talentless mercenary, was no exception. Fortunately for him, a mysterious item he finds before his untimely death sends him back to the past. Now a 13-year-old with a second chance at life, Sungmin begins his desperate journey to become Aeria's strongest with no money or talent. The question is... will effort alone be enough to make a hero of a boy with absolutely nothing?

147041.description:
A baby is a fascinating creature: it can be cute, it can be impressive, and it can also be immensely weird. This series of 2-panel comic strips gives a glimpse into a life of rearing an eccentric infant, all rendered in a simple and comedic style reminiscent of early animated Japanese internet memes.

Based on a series of popular tweets featuring drawn renditions of humorous anecdotes from the author's own experience raising a baby, this book version is primarily made up of newly penned comic strips, as well as essays and a number of multi-page stories.

Note: Originally published on Twitter and collated by Kadokawa for print release.

Ao and Takaomi are two childhood friends living near an industrial area. Keeping their feelings hidden from one another, they carry on with their daily lives in high school.

"It's our final summer in school. Let's go see the factory nightscapes—just the two of us." This is their promise, as a romance begins to bloom. However, an incident spells turmoil for their budding relationship, placing them at the mercy of an unstoppable fate...

The first work in the social awareness series; the story of two people's persistent love in a world of absurdity.

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

147044.description: One day, a juvenile delinquent, Eiji Razor, instinctively sensed danger and hid himself in the basement of an abandoned warehouse. When he went outside after a long rain, he saw a town taken over by the Worst, nocturnal creatures that are born from human corpses and can regenerate even after being dismembered. A dreadful virus was mixed in the rain that killed humans and turned them into Worst. While fighting off the Worst, Eiji found survivors including Taku Maejima, a young boy, Harry, an American soldier, and Tozaki, a delinquent student, and they hid in the Kasumigaseki Building as a fortress.

147045.description:
Make way for the queen!

A weak, C-list actress falls into the sea and returns with a 180-degree temperament change as a frightening and ruthless killer. Bigwigs from all walks of life humbly submit to her. Now referred to as the "Reaper", the queen both entertains and punishes evil. Shh, here comes the queen!

(Source: Manta)

147046.description:
Ex-convict Park Mok-Hwa wants nothing more than to keep his head low and stay out of anything that has to do with his past. However, his new-found tranquility as a florist is shattered by the appearance of Kim Nak-won, corrupt cop and unabashed hedonist. Nak-Won is sure that Mok-Hwa’s the key to cracking an important case, and he’ll do anything to get the taciturn man to talk. The best way to make someone confess is to cause them pain, and Nak-Won thinks he knows just what’ll hurt Mok-Hwa the most. But despite Nak-Won’s best efforts, Mok-Hwa continues to stay silent. It’s not often that life doesn’t go the way Nak-Won wants it to, so his obsession with Mok-Hwa only grows stronger...

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Beware of the Full Moon in March

147047.description:
Chasing superpowered criminals.

A bank heist… committed by people with superpowers. When this news reaches police officer Young-In Jin, he suspects it could be linked to a meteorite crash he saw with his friends years ago. What are his childhood friends hiding? And why does he suddenly wake up in a strange room? As he digs deeper into the case, some shocking truths are revealed...

(Source: Manta)

147048.description:
“Daddy doesn’t smile anymore. Do you think he hates me?”

After losing his wife, Tsubasa spends his days with his five year old son Sora whilst trying to balance his job, household chores and childrearing. Wishing to raise his son to be a respected adult, Tsubasa continues to show a strict side to his son and gradually loses his smile. However it is at this moment that the straightforward and sociable Hiro moves into the same apartment. Upon witnessing the demanding life Tsubasa lives, Hiro decides to lend a hand, but for Tsubasa who doesn’t know how to rely on others, will Hiro’s efforts reach him…?

(Source: Kobunsha, translated)

She initially thinks that she’s the chosen one and is at the top of the world, but it turns out that her husbands are trying to kill her. She has no choice but to farm and run a business in order to improve her situation. Beautiful men then come running to hit on her. Out of jealousy, her husbands push her down. “Are you trying to avoid taking responsibility now that you’ve slept with us?”

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Minerva, a duchess, has given up on marriage after two broken engagements. At a tea party she was forced to attend by Celica, an isekai person, the heartbroken Minerva is confronted by a man...

It was Rufus, the second prince of the empire, known as "The Dark Prince," widely feared as a capable but ruthless man! However, Celica, who does not care about court etiquette, starts to act rudely toward Rufus as well. Minerva quickly defends Rufus from the tyrannical Celica. Rufus takes notice of her resolute attitude, and asks her to stay with him...? The two gradually come to a know each other, and soon find themselves working together to deal with the disturbances caused by Celica and the other isekai people! While trying to solve the problem, they discover that Minerva has a special ability of her own......?

See how the love pours out of the ruthless prince to heal the wounds in their hearts, as the doting fantasy romance begins!

147070.description:
"Osananajimi Ojou-sama ga Jama wo shite, Futsuu no Love-Kome ga Dekinai" or Ojo-Jama for short, is my favorite rom-com manga, and it's getting an anime adaptation! My favorite girl is the so-called "losing heroine," Sei Shimada. She may seem cool on the outside, but she is actually quite shy, and the gap moe is super cute. Right now, she's standing right there in front of me, and I'm looking right at her......!

(Oh, is this a dream? If so, I'd like to say a few words before I wake up.)

"I like you."

"Wha…!? What are you talking about, Hisamura?"

I'm apparently in the body of Tsukasa Hisamura, the male lead's best friend. But I don't care about the plot, as long as I can tell Sei-chan that I love her. I'm already totally satisfied, but I'm still not waking up from this dream...... Maybe I'm in a comic book! Then I'll do just have to my best to make my favorite character happy!

(Source: Sneaker Bunko, translated)

Wanted! is a one-shot manga by Eiichiro Oda, produced during his senior year of high school in 1992. It was submitted under the pseudonym Tsuki Himizu Kikondo to the 44th Tezuka Awards and won Second Class, earning Oda ¥500,000 and marking his debut in the manga industry.

Per convention at the time, Wanted! was collected with its fellow winners in a single Mezase Mangaka volume, published in early 1993. After One Piece brought Oda to new prominence, it was reprinted in the September 1998 issue of Akamaru Jump, followed by a self-titled collection dedicated to one-shots from Oda's early career.

(Source: One Piece Wiki)

Elizabeth Leiston, daughter of the influential prime minister, is a picture-perfect lady on the path to becoming the future queen of the Kingdom of Haldoria. But her life takes a sudden turn for the worst when her fiancé makes a show of publicly calling off their engagement. Soon after, he throws her in jail and starts spreading nasty rumors about her. The encouragement Elizabeth receives from her loyal waiting maid, Mireille, and her inner fury are all she needs to reconsider her goals. Why should she continue devoting herself to a country that doesn’t respect her when she can trample over it instead? She will get even with those who wronged her and bring down the damned kingdom, even if it’s the last thing she does! Luckily, Elizabeth is no damsel in distress and has seven powerful magic grimoires she won’t hesitate to use. Get ready because this ruthless lady is out for blood!

Hikaru's got a problem that only his long-time friend can solve! Newly single, Hikaru confides in Shinori how hard bachelor life has been since he was dumped. 147295.description:
What Do-Hyun lacks in character, he makes up for with his looks and wealth. After cutting his studies abroad short, he returns to Korea, relying on his fortune as a safety net. Life feels predictable—until a call from his real estate agent brings him to his building, Ye-Yeon. To his dismay, Do-Hyun finds himself trapped in an elevator with a strikingly handsome man who, much to his surprise, seems completely unimpressed when Do-Hyun casually reveals that he owns the building. The encounter leaves Do-Hyun both baffled and intrigued. Unable to shake the memory of the mysterious Jeong Hyun, who turns out to work in his building, Do-Hyun begins to pursue him. What starts as an infuriating elevator mishap soon spirals into a series of unpredictable run-ins in the most unlikely places. As the tension between them grows, a barrage of witty banter and undeniable chemistry keeps pulling them closer together.

147304.description:
Having to work with someone who goes out of their way to annoy you is trying, to say the least. Nox Perses doesn’t understand why Allon Hemera is so bent on making his life miserable. The captain of the Edelfelt knights is charming, gentle, and affable with everyone apart from Nox. To make matters worse, Allon also refuses to remember the magical night the two spent together a few years ago, even though Nox adamantly believes that it was a night no one could forget. Still, now that the war is over, Nox is looking forward to not staring at his enemy’s face. Little does he know about the proposal Allon will spring on him...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Chapter count includes two special episodes.

147306.description:
After flunking the civil service exam, Kim Youngsoo spends his days working part-time at a pork cutlet restaurant, struggling to make ends meet. He plans to give the exam another shot down the line, but for now, his small moments of happiness in his mundane life come from treating the cute guy who drops by the restaurant to pork cutlets every now and again. Amidst the routine of his simple and peaceful life, an unexpected disruption arrives in the form of his neighbor, Lim Joongdo: a rude and conceited jerk who hurls insults at Youngsoo from the moment they meet. Frustrated and disheartened, Youngsoo chooses to just ignore Joongdo completely. But then...out of the blue, Joongdo does a complete 180 and starts acting all sugary and sweet. Did Joongdo genuinely have a change of heart, or is he sugarcoating his words to hide a bitter motive?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 26 extra chapters.

147307.description:
Kyowoo's department buzzes with excitement when the handsome executive director's son, Jiwook, joins as a new recruit. But oddly enough, the other quieter recruit, Leehak, catches Kyowoo's eye more. Could it be because of his clumsiness when it comes to basic office tasks, his subtly aloof attitude at work, or the fact that he wears the same cologne as Kyowoo's crush in high school? Either way, Kyowoo suspects that he's related to someone important at the company, but pretends not to notice. In his efforts to treat Leehak normally, however, Kyowoo ends up capturing his romantic interest. What's more, Leehak turns out to be the son of none other than the company's chairman! Though Kyowoo is reluctant to come off as a hyena after his wealth, Leehak remains persistent... and Kyowoo doesn't exactly dislike him, either. Will the two come together in an unexpected office romance, despite the many hurdles in their relationship?

(Source: Tappytoon)

147309.description:
After unknowingly helping a mysterious elderly woman, a hardworking company manager finds his life spiraling into a series of absurdly suggestive, romantic-comedy-style situations that seem pulled from an erotic webtoon. 147312.description:

However, Seo-Jin blacks out at the last drinking party and is forcibly kicked out of the site with only a large amount of sponsorship money. A few years later, they reunite at work as a team leader and a new employee. The money he received as sponsorship money has long since been spent. To the frozen Seo-Jin, the team leader (?) makes an offer he can’t refuse… No matter the place! No matter the time! Seo-Jin’s chaotic office life begins now as he goes against the no-break calls of the perverted team leader.

147313.description:
Han Kang, who has just been discharged from the military, meets a naked stranger, Kang Rae-In, at his older sister's house that he visited after a long time. Han Kang, who mistakes the adult Kang Rae-In for a high school student with nowhere to go, takes pity on him and invites him into his room, and the two suddenly start living together...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

147314.description:
These days, shadow guards not only have to be good at carrying out assassinations, but they also face the risk of being sent away if they elicit the ire of their master. What Shadow fears most isn't punishment, but being abandoned by his lord. Heart-broken and exhausted, even a stone can fracture under enormous pressure, let alone a human. When Shadow finally learned to let go, the man who once treated him with disdain refuses to give him up.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

147315.description:
A poor boy who is often pitied travels over to the Magic Continent and is sent to the palace as the reincarnation of the former queen. In his previous life, he had a family with a husband who spoiled him, but he was also used to being the ‘vicious stepmother’ of his “children”.

147316.description: A boy and a girl made a promise to marry when they were young. They meet again as adults, but the boy has grown up to be a very frivolous man...?

In reality, it's only run by a boss with the features of a child, and a reticent warrior, yet it dominates the leaderboards of bounty hunts in the martial world, and is well known all over. What is the secret behind their success? When their competitors come looking for trouble, where would their paths lie?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

In his previous life, he was a cold-hearted and indecent Great Master, Ma Jiasheng! And, in this life, he is a small actor, Ma Lanyin, who is at ease with acting. 147319.description:
Soh Fujima has not been able to recover from grief after his cat's recent passing. Nobody has seen or heard from him for ages, and he and his apartment are a mess. Fujima lives on the sixth street, where many residents have been complaining about the neighborhood's cat infestation. As he was holed up in his room, Fujima was unaware of the dire situation the stray cats of the sixth street were facing. Just as he was witnessing the capturing of stray cats to be sent off to their demise, a mysteriously strong figure appears in front of him to stop the barbarism: Maki Mishima. How will Mishima try to stop these people from trying to get rid of the stray cats? Will Fujima be able to be of any help? And what in the world exactly is a "cat-munity"?!

(Source: Manga Planet)

Seeing more and more these weird phenomenons appearing, people were on the verge of madness, yet only detective Kate is enjoying the adventure. As he approaches the dark, the monster that lays within is creeping towards him...

147326.description:
Myung-Ha, cast out by his family and forced to live a lonely life as a gravekeeper, is suddenly tasked by his father with a peculiar “errand.” What seemed like a simple task brings him to none other than the estate of Grand Prince Howon, Yi Sa-Hwon. In the blink of an eye, Myung-Ha goes from being a gravekeeper to the wife of the enigmatic prince. Alone in an unfamiliar place, the only warmth Myung-Ha can rely on comes from Sa-Hwon’s kindness. Yet that kindness proves dangerous to trust, for the Sa-Hwon of the night is an entirely different man...

(Source: Lezhin US)

147327.description:
Chiharu isn't what you'd expect of a top-class host. Though he certainly dazzles his customers while on the clock, he actually spends most of his day raising a child! After his older sister's tragic death in an accident, Chiharu is determined to be the best guardian possible for his young nephew, Akito. In a stroke of bad luck, though, Chiharu finds himself injured, temporarily out of work, and rained out of his apartment! Thankfully, Chiharu and Akito are offered shelter by a kind couple at a temple... whose son just happens to be someone from Chiharu's past! What will happen when they're forced to suddenly live together...!?

(Source: Renta!)

147328.description:
Ju-Won Kim is somewhat satisfied with his life despite his position as a temp worker after barely making it out of a diploma mill. He's been keeping his sexuality as a gay man his top secret ever since he discovered his sexual preference in his teenage years. Independently, he runs into Gang-Hyeok at his favourite bar one weekend. Gang-Hyeok Choi, the general headquarters manager of a conglomerate, is a perfect man with an outstanding appearance, business mind, manners, and class. Ju-Won, thinking Gang-Hyeok would never find out who he is, ends up having a one-nighter... "Is this emotion right now... some sort of love...?" "This is a flame that will go off sooner or later, just a passion and lust, not love." Game-of-tag romance between Gang-Hyeok, who thinks it's love, and Ju-Won, who says it's a delusion, begins.

(Source: NETCOMICS)

147329.description:
A hitman and a marriage swindler set out on the world’s most grueling battle for marriage! Gero is a young man from a clan of hitmen, which has been in existence for hundreds of years. As someone who’s never gone to school and lived his life dealing in the dark side of the business, he considers himself to have “no prospects with women” and marriage as “something not for him.” However, one day, in fear that their lineage would dissolve, his clan warns Gero that if he doesn’t marry and produce an heir, they would have no choice but to…force his little sister into doing “that.” Driven to his wits’ end, Gero asks the target of his work, a marriage swindler, to…

147330.description:
By a strange twist of fate, Jin Yi Kwon, a photographer in need of a part-time assistant, ends up hiring Beom Jisoo, his first love. The two meet in a café after 13 years but instead of the tiny and adorable Beom Jisoo Jin Yi Kwon fell in love with, a muscular hunk shows up. Unlike Jin Yi Kwon who immediately recognizes Beom Jisoo, Beom Jisoo doesn’t seem to remember Jin Yi Kwon. What will happen to these two? Will Jin Lee Kwon finally confess his feelings towards Beom Jisoo after all these years?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

147331.description:
Ellie, who runs a restaurant in the capital, is an unfriendly but conscientious chef. While he's living peacefully, he falls for his regular customer's trick and is forced to accompany him on a suspicious trip…

The rest of the group, a cruel swordsman and a playboy mage, cannot be trusted, and the endless journey is dangerous. A forest with ancient trees, a mountain range where snow leopards lurk, a cooking competition in a fancy city, and even a thief in a ballroom. A strange adventure awaits them.

Chester, a fearless prosecutor, began a journey he thought was troublesome, but then developed a weakness that he didn't want to reveal to anyone. Pablo Fairvissel, one of the 17 wise men and a royal doctor, finds himself at a crossroads between cowardice and loyalty when he discovers suspicious circumstances during a mission he considered a vacation.

The group gets closer day by day, and before they know it, they have set foot in the enemy country. Will they be able to return to Antilla after their arduous journey? A story of a grand conspiracy, inevitable fate, and insignificant heroes who conflict within it.

147340.description:
Sol Kwon is a moody art major whose life gets shaken up by the arrival of Jeebin Bae—a modeling major who volunteers to pose for the art classes. Sol is attracted to Jeebin, but two factors hold him back. One, his personality isn’t as good as his face, and two… he is dating Sol’s sister. Things take a turn when Sol’s sister breaks up with Jeebin to travel to Europe. Suddenly, Jeebin starts acting differently around Sol… Is Jeebin genuinely interested in Sol? Or is he only giving Sol the time of day because he reminds him of his sister?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes 23 side story chapters.

147342.description:
Uncomfortable around people and hiding from his past mistakes, Lee Seo-Ha moves into his grandma's house in the hopes of a bit of peace and quiet. Little does he know, his grandma has plans to take on a tenant—and not just any tenant, but a half-bird man named Shane who pays in raw gemstones and claims to have known Seo-Ha in a past life! Whether friend or foe, this feathered fellow claims that Seo-Ha's real name is Hearth, and that he needs to serve him for three lifetimes in order to demonstrate his virtue. Shane claims that this is the only way for Seo-Ha—fine, Hearth—to regain his position in the heavens. The thing is, while the wings may be undeniable, there's still no proof that Shane isn’t just a bird-brained lunatic. So why does he seem so familiar...?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

147343.description: All actors in Tsubaki Theatre are male, regardless of whether they play male or female roles on stage, but don't let that fool you—the enchanting beauty of their performances has earned Tsubaki renown as one of Japan's foremost theatre companies. Young actors gather at Tsubaki Senior High School to train, in the hopes of one day joining the company, and it is here where Hachinoda Youichi, a once-aspiring screenwriter who gave up on his dreams, meets Hayashi Shingo, a Tsubaki trainee with looks so stunning he could pass for a girl. Shingo's performances in female roles draw praise from his teachers and peers, but something weighs heavily on his mind...

147344.description:
Tomo is madly in love with "Sakura," a character from a love simulation game. Then, one day, he finds out that the guy who moved in next door to him, Chihiro, looks just like her. Tomo's desire was for his first time to be with Sakura, but when he comes face-to-face with Chihiro, the combination of Chihiro's desperate advances along with his enchanting looks makes Tomo quickly change his mind about that. Chihiro has strange tastes and smokes completely naked, so he's nothing like the sweet and innocent Sakura... But with Tomo being completely new to pleasures of the flesh, he can't keep his mind off of Chihiro! And, to top it off, Chihiro's ex-boyfriend makes an unannounced visit! What will they do!? 147359.description:
When he was young, he followed his father to the palace, but happened to meet Crown Prince Gi-Ryeon. Sin-Yeon falls in love at first sight when he sees a manly and beautiful prince, and Gi-Ryeon also likes Sin-Yeon's innocent and pretty appearance. As time goes by Sin-Yeon realizes what he feels like every time he meets Gi-Ryeon, he eventually leaves for a dangerous outskirts to control his growing heart.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

147360.description:
New magical girls arriving on the scene means a new collection of tales about their lives! You’ll get to experience the bonus origin story “Snow White Raising Project” for the first time in print—a mustread as Snow White’s character arc reaches its climax. Don’t miss out on these episodes that are sure to add even more color and intrigue to the Magical Girl Raising Project series!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: 魔法少女育成計画 エピソードシグマ
Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku: episodes sigma

title.english: Magical Girl Raising Project: Episodes S

147361.description:
A world where humans and mermaids coexist. Dong-I, a rabbit mermaid, applies for the Dragon King's critical condition after hearing the news that the government is offering a huge reward to mermaids who provide the rabbit's appendix. But the contract is strange...? He has to inject the rabbit mermaid Gong Ja-Ran's... into his body?!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

147363.description:
One day, the moon crashes into the heart of the city, and nothing is ever the same again. Half the city lies in ruins, and in its wake, people begin awakening strange new powers. These espers soon split into two factions: those who serve the city as government-licensed protectors, and those who live among the fallen moon, wielding their powers by their own rules. When government golden-boy Kang Jin-Woong finds himself suddenly reliant on none other than Jae-Heo, the rebellious leader of the moon-born resistance, everything he thinks he knows starts to come into question. Enemies by fate, drawn together by something deeper…can their connection survive a world on the edge of collapse?

(Source: Lezhin US)

147366.description:
Stigmata—bodily scars that appear on the same places where Christ was wounded. Rescued from his old village that underwent a terrible massacre of the residents, Sion suffers from memory loss. It seems Sion's troubles have come to an end now, with him living his days out peacefully as an apprentice priest. But things take another turn when he's accused wrongly of taking something from "the Holy King" Siennas Del Mayee, and dies a gruesome death...only to be reborn in the body of the king himself. Now Sion must navigate his way through living as royalty with only Pavel at his side, the very handsome but rather untrustworthy high priest...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: The R15 version is completed with 158 chapters. On December 20th, 2022 a R19 version released and is completed with 165 chapters.

147367.description:
In the 13th century, Poland's Puotsk region, the territory of the Krömer family, where the German knights were sent and stationed, where public trade was active and prisoners of other ethnicities were enslaved.

A man without a pass carrying a big ax appears in front of the gatekeeper, Andy, and suddenly attacks him when he asks to see his pass.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

147368.description: A murder mystery set in a coastal town school about the death of a popular and pretty high school girl. As the truth about her death unfolds, the school's ground is filled with an eerie atmosphere.

147373.description:
The story centers on Kuon Kanae, a junior high school student who was in Tokyo on the day white feathers fell. Kuon sometimes sees feathers on people's back, and sometimes sees the sky filled with black letters…

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: The manga takes place after the story of Tenshi Kinryouku (Angel Sanctuary), but it is an independent work.

title.native: 天使禁猟区-東京クロノス-

147375.description:
Claire François has it all: beauty, brains, and the blood of nobility. As the daughter of a high-ranking noble, she takes her status and the according responsibilities with utmost seriousness—even as the king threatens to undermine his realm’s stability with his visions of “meritocracy.” Claire is nevertheless prepared to take this societal change in stride, until one of the new commoner students at her elite academy, Rae Taylor, turns her life upside down. Everything about Rae confounds Claire, from her behavior to her intellect to her bizarre fixation on Claire herself. Little does she realize just how much Rae will change her world, and how much she’ll change Rae in turn. A retelling of the original series from Claire's perspective.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Chapter count includes 8 main chapters, 18 intermission chapters, an epilogue, and 3 postscript chapters.
synonyms: Me enamoré de la villana: ¡Qué plebeya tan descarada!

title.english: I’m in Love with the Villainess: She’s so Cheeky for a Commoner
title.native: 平民のくせに生意気な！
title.romaji: Heimin no Kuse ni Namaiki na!

147376.description: Riko, who struggles at getting along with people, is worried she doesn’t belong anywhere. Then, one day, she meets the super popular Sagara. She is stunned by his comments that she's awkward. But when he asks for a kiss, she can't turn him down.
synonyms: I can't say no to Sagara-kun!

title.native: 相良くんだけは、拒めない

147377.description:
There’s nothing more shocking than your crush turning into a meaningless doodle you scribbled in class. That’s what happened to normal college student Do-Yun Lee, who has feelings for his handsome roommate Ji-Won Woo. One day, Do-yun confesses to Ji-Won, who doesn’t exactly respond the way Do-Yun had hoped he would. The heartbroken Do-yun draws an “ugly” version of Ji-Won, and when he gets home, he’s stunned to find Ji-Won looks exactly like his drawing. To end the unexpected curse, the two will have to face chaotic obstacles - and their undeniable attraction to each other.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.
synonyms: 我把暗恋对象变成了涂鸦小人？
ロマンチック・グラフィティ
I Turned My Crush into a Doodle Figure

147378.description: The birth and development of imperial Rome during the rule of the Giulio-Claudia family: from Julius Caesar to Nero. The first volume is entitled Julius Caesar, the man who held the fate of the world in his hand. A comics attentive to historical coherence, documented and complete: for a compelling approach to great history and its protagonists. The first volume is entirely dedicated to the extraordinary figure of Julius Caesar, the senator who, centered on himself the power and all the major republican offices, laid the foundations of the Empire. The conquest campaigns of the great Roman leader are retraced; love for Cleopatra; the dictatorship and death by Brutus, the adopted son.
synonyms: Manga History of the Roman Empire
アウグストゥス、揺るぎなき帝国の礎
カリグラ、ネロ、ユリウス朝の崩壊
ユリウス・カエサル、世界の運命を握った男

title.native: マンガ ローマ帝国の歴史

147379.description:
The high school boy Yin Yongtian suffered from a strong case of OCD. He got on the wrong side of a bully when his OCD caused the bully's proposal to go wrong. He was almost beaten to death, but the trauma activated his Compulsive System! Yin Yongtian wasn't actually all that interested in cultivation, but the System kept tempting him with missions like ”Unanswered Notifications", “Almost Acquired Proficiency," and “Extremely Irregular Hexagonal Panels,” which triggered his compulsion to finish them and become stronger! With skills more than a hundred times more powerful than regular people, he and his friends will venture into the dungeons, and his compulsions will set him on the pathway to becoming the strongest.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: Because of My OCD I Became a King

147380.description:
A dizzying office love affair between an S-class esper and a B-class guide! Lee Jaeha, a B-class guide, had an office relationship with an esper at the same center for 3 years, but was recently done wrong. Despite breaking up with his lover, he finds himself forced to still guide him, and he applies for a transfer to a high-risk area. Surrounded by all kinds of rumors and stares, all he wants is a quiet and peaceful work life in the new center! However, Jaeha takes on the task of guiding Do Jiyoon, an S-class esper, on the verge of a rampage, and Jaeha’s work life is getting farther away from peaceful…!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

147381.description:
I am pleased to announce that I am engaged to a handsome CEO after 0 days of dating.
*But he likes to wears a bra.

Keiko is a 34-year-old office lady who dreamed too much about marrying a high spec man. But instead she has been disappointed as she was getting past marriageable age. One day, Keiko found out the secret fetish of the second-generation CEO of her company, who was supposed to be the "ideal bachelor." Out of her stress from work and a sense of mischievousness, she threatened him by saying, "I'll ignore the female underwear, if you'll marry me." But the CEO seemed very enthusiastic about the idea and began to treat her like a doting lover!?

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)
synonyms: でも同僚は女装している。
でもふたりは〇〇をつけない。
Demo Shachou wa Bra wo Shite iru
But My CEO Wears a Bra

title.native: それでも社長はブラをしている。
title.romaji: Soredemo Shachou wa Bra wo Shiteiru.

147383.description:
One day, the game streamer Bai Xinxin transmigrated into the role of the princess Bai Yueguang in the mystery game "Nightingale and the Rose". But all the characters in this game were out to kill her, and only Lan Sha, the player character, could protect her. Amongst all the jealous yanderes and murderous rivals, Bai Yueguang has to use all her wits to fight off enemies known and unknown, while finding a way to survive with Lan Sha by her side. However, this main character "Lan Sha" also seems a bit...?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

147384.description:
Siblings, unrelated by blood and acquainted in the face of animosity, are about to embark into one hell of a forbidden romance.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

147385.description:
Jamie approached a college student in order to eliminate him as the target of a murder contract. But what type of student dresses with a bullet-proof vest?! Jamie is soon overpowered by the target, 'Angelo,' and learns that his elder brother, Gabe (his client), will not let him fail the assignment. As a result, Jamie devises a plan to sway Angelo's opinion...

"Would you rather kill both me and him, or fuck with me and kill your brother?"

Note: The chapter count includes 3 extra chapters.

147386.description: A young man discovers that his mother has been going out with a sugar baby for a while. But is that really what is happening? A heartfelt story of finding love and family.

147390.description:
Juwon’s just had the worst breakup of his life. So what does he do to get over his jerk of an ex? Sleep with his best friend, of course. Jiwook’s always been there when Juwon’s needed someone, always coming right over without question. But then, he has to go and talk about his feelings during their drunken night of sex… But maybe it isn’t a bad thing, since Juwon’s been starting to look at Jiwook differently since that night, too. Maybe going out with your good-looking best friend won’t be that bad at all. Just friends, friends with benefits, or lovers? The tension between the two becomes palpable, and whatever they’ve become now, it sure tastes sweet like vanilla…

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 魔法の少尉ブラスターマリ

147409.description:
Serialized in Cyber Comics with GAINAX credited for creating the original story for the first two chapters. Also known as the “Jupiter Trilogy.”

Two years after the end of the One Year War, the space fortress ship “Aria”—the only manned spacecraft in Jupiter’s orbit—is on a mission to destroy a factory ship constructed in Jupiter’s orbit to cut off the Federation’s supply of helium. Johnny Ridden and Tita, a female pilot believed to be a Newtype, who are aboard the Aria, are attacked by a phantom of Char. (Jupiter Mirage-1 and 2)

Physical chemist Niki Shimazu, protesting the Jupiter Orbit Research Foundation’s concealment of technology, seized the helium collection ship “Acta” and descended toward Jupiter. The Republic of Zeon hastily secured the Foundation as a sponsor and dispatched the deep-space vessel “Helldiver” to Jupiter with a crew of five. (Jupiter Mirage-3)

(Source: All That Gundam, translated)

147412.description:
Kaoru Shabana's been coddled his whole life and yearns to remake himself into a splendid grown-up—a true man among men. Seeking a fresh start at achieving independence, he enrolls in a prestigious academy on a remote island. There, he meets Kanra, a tantalizingly tall young woman, who reveals that the school of his dreams is actually a nest of succubi! Reduced to little more than a devil's plaything, can Kaoru escape from this heavenly prison before he's sucked dry?!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: The Devil Fascinates Me in Heavenly Prison.

title.english: In the Heavenly Prison, the Devil Enchants Me
title.native: 天獄で悪魔がボクを魅惑する
title.romaji: Tengoku de Akuma ga Boku wo Miwaku Suru

147413.description:
Stuck in a game with a lousy hero? Me too!

Min-Jun, a normal office worker, wakes up inside the game he was reviewing for his friend. It's not his fault the trailer was so boring it put him to sleep! Bewildered, Min-Jun is tasked with summoning a hero to guide. The hero certainly looks strong, but he seems to be less useful than expected.

(Source: Manta, edited)
synonyms: ตั้งใจเลือกฮีโร่ให้ดี
An Eromanga Drawn by a Real Honest Guy

title.native: めちゃくちゃ正直者が描いたエロ漫画

147416.description:
Hiding both his real name Yu-Han and his past as a dominant Omega, Lee Ha-Jin lives quietly as a Beta, drowning in debt and scraping by as a personal aide to the spoiled son of J Tech’s CEO. With no family to rely on, survival is his only goal. Everything changes when Ha-Jin runs into Kwon Seong-Hyeob, his first love from high school, at a business meeting. Once the son of his family’s chauffeur, Seong-Hyeob is now a powerful corporate leader. Time has reversed their positions, but their pheromones still recognize each other as if no years have passed. In this new, twisted dynamic, Seong-Hyeob refuses to let Ha-Jin disappear again. Determined to keep him close, he proposes a dangerous arrangement that blurs the line between desire, control, and unresolved love.

Between secrets, power, and lingering attraction, Ha-jin must decide whether he can survive being pulled back into the past he tried so hard to escape.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.
synonyms: リバーサル〜運命の再会～

147418.description:
Xu Su, a novelist suffering from a mental disorder, somehow managed to summon Zhong Ye, an evil spirit from his novel. Despite Xu Su’s best efforts to eliminate Zhong Ye, he was pushed to the edge of insanity again and again. To free himself from this torment, Xu Su finally fulfilled Zhong Ye’s wish and unlocked the seal. But his life did not return to the peaceful days that Xu Su had hoped for. “Surely you know, that if you make a deal with the devil, sooner or later you’ll lose yourself to him…”

(Source: Manman Manhua, translated)

147424.description:
If you're full, you'll be happy.

Even if you're not in the city, even if you don't have money, if you're full, you'll be happy.

A little bit far from the city, there sits a mountain village filled with greenery. Junior high school students Kimi and Shiromi lives there with their three chickens. Even though they don't have parents, they don't mind. Because, you can fill your stomach with 'eggs'! Let's take a peek at their mountain village life.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: あなたがわたしにくれたもの
title.romaji: Anata ga Watashi ni Kureta Mono

147426.description:
U-Jae was raised by his mother who was obsessed with shamanism. The day U-Jae got tired of her mother's obssession, he refused to pray for the first time. His mother, on the other hand, died that day on a car accident. Suffering from guilt, U-Jae began to suffer from a strange symptoms of seeing futile things, sleeping and having nightmares from time to time, and wonders whether he should visit the shaman again. At that time, a man called Imugi and suggests that he can cure U-Jae's symptoms.

But... The treatment includes skinship?
Can I trust this man?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

147427.description: A recent college graduate struggles to find a job that fits his abilities, but one day he is hired by a strange company where all the employees have flashy tattoos. The young man meets the charismatic leader of the group and finds out that he is working for the yakuza.

title.native: 半グレ―六本木 摩天楼のレクイエム―

147433.description:
Kato, a police officer in a small town, usually didn't have much to do, but lately he's been strangely busy. He was hoping to get some extra help when suddenly a three-headed monster appeared!

"I'm the guard dog of hell, Cerberus! Hire me as a police dog!"

(Source: Nico Nico Seiga, translated)

title.native: ケルベロスのおまわりさん

147434.description:
It's been over a year since Takumi and Aki became roommates. They split housework perfectly, pay their bills on time, and their private lives are smooth sailing... or so Takumi makes it seem. He harbors deep feelings for Aki and hides them at all costs to preserve their harmonious lifestyle. However, Takumi's feelings get out, and now he fears the destruction of their relationship. On his 20th birthday, when he reaches legal drinking age, he drowns his sorrows in a bottle... and the minute he and Aki end up alone together, he makes a serious blunder.

(Source Renta!)

title.native: 後宮灼姫伝　～妹の身代わりをしていたら、いつの間にか皇帝や将軍に寵愛されています～
title.romaji: Koukyuden: Imouto no Migawari wo Shiteitara, Itsunomanika Koutei ya Shougun ni Chouai Sareteimasu

title.native: 家から逃げ出したい私が、うっかり憧れの大魔法使い様を買ってしまったら
title.romaji: Ie kara Nigedashitai Watashi ga, Ukkari Akogare no Daimahoutsukai-sama wo Katteshimattara

title.native: お前のような初心者がいるか！ 不遇職『召喚師』なのにラスボスと言われているそうです
title.romaji: Omae no Youna Shoshinsha ga Iruka! Fuguushoku "Summoner" Nanoni Last Boss to Iwareteiru Soudesu

title.native: 灼熱の魔女様の楽しい温泉領地経営 ~追放された公爵令嬢、災厄級のあたためスキルで世界最強の温泉帝国を築きます~
title.romaji: Shakunetsu no Majo-sama no Tanoshii Onsen Ryouchi Keiei: Tsuihou Sareta Koushaku Reijou, Saiyakukyuu no Atatame Skill de Sekai Saikyou no Onsen Teikoku wo Kizukimasu

147441.description:
Kaya-chan is a notorious problem child in her kindergarten, but none of the adults know her secret–till Chie-sensei is put in charge and learns of Kaya-chan's hidden ability to see evil spirits and vanquish them with a punch! What will happen to this five-year-old who gets in trouble when she’s only trying to help?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: カヤちゃんはコワくない

147442.description:
Lim Chan-Yeong was often physically punished by his teachers as a student, causing him to believe that he was masochistic. At the academy where he works part-time, he meets Goo Dong-Ha, a teacher with massive masochistic tendencies. Due to a drunken encounter, Dong-Ha mistakes Chan-Yeong for a sadist and the two embark on a whirlwind BDSM adventure together.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three side story chapters.

147443.description:
Yeon Seung-Heon. The nation's beloved actor, the friend I grew up with, and my ex-boyfriend who disappeared seven years ago. Then he suddenly appeared on a same-sex marriage program called "Happy Marriage"...? I'll figure it out this time. Why the hell did he leave me and then suddenly reappear?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

title.native: 僕たち、私たちは、『本気の勉強』がしたい。
title.romaji: Bokutachi, Watashitachi wa, "Honki ni Benkyou" ga Shitai.

title.native: 迷宮宿屋 ~空間魔法使い少女の細腕繁盛記~
title.romaji: Miekyuu Yadoya: Kuukan Mahou Tsukai Shoujo no Hosoude Hanjouki

147446.description:
"Hey, why are you always pretending to be asleep?

During recess, Miran Hanazuki keeps trying to talk to Shuji Nagasawa. He was puzzled by her behavior, until his parents unexpectedly tells him, "We're sorry for telling you this now, but actually, you have a fiancee......!" What's more, his promised bride is Miran, the girl who is always getting on his nerves!

Now they spend time together at lunch and after school. He is confused by the sudden new relationship at first, but even then, Miran always treats him kindly. He's not sure what to expect in the future, but he's sure they'll be able to find a way.

A shy guy and a gal, two opposites come together in this lovey-dovey comedy!

(Source: Over-Lap, translated)
synonyms: One Day, Out of the Blue, I got a Gal's Forgiving Wife.
เมื่อผมจับพลัดจับผลูมีคู่หมั้นเป็นสาวแกล

title.native: ある日突然、ギャルの許嫁ができた
title.romaji: Aruhi Totsuzen, Gal no Iinazuke ga Dekita

147447.description:
A heavy mist has fallen over the world, twisting many humans into horrifying monsters. Humanity is losing the battle against these grotesque fiends, but it is not entirely without defenses. Leon Crossheart is an adventurer, a hero, a hunter of ghouls... and a ghoul himself ! His strength and regenerative ability are unmatched, but this power comes at a price: He’s reviled by the very people he strives to protect. However, there is one girl he saved who sees beyond his frightening appearance. Alice is so grateful that she wants to be his disciple, and she isn’t taking no for an answer! Will she bring light into his dark and bloodstained life, or will he keep her—and therefore his own salvation—out of reach?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Only I Know the Ghoul Saved the World
title.native: グールが世界を救ったことを私だけが知っている
title.romaji: Ghoul ga Sekai wo Sukutta Koto wo Watashi dake ga Shitteiru

title.native: デスゲームで救ってくれたから、私をあなたの好きにしていいよ
title.romaji: Death Game de Sukutte Kureta kara, Watashi wo Anata no Suki ni Shite Ii yo

147449.description:
Every year, the school holds a contest to determine the school's No. 1 heroine/goddess/"muse." Jiyun's childhood friend Tsugumi Aiba was the winner of the previous year's contest. Jiyun had a crush on Tsugumi, but it wasn't reciprocated, so he wanted to do something as revenge for Tsugumi's rejection. That was when his inconspicuous classmate, Takahina Uzura, asked him to help her win the goddess contest...?

(Source: Pocket Comics, translated)
synonyms: I Wish You Were My Muse

title.native: きみが女神ならいいのに
title.romaji: Kimi ga Megami Nara Ii no ni

147450.description:
Serve up only the best! On graduation day, U-Jeong confesses his affection for fellow classmate Yeong-Ung. His big news is rejected, however, and they move on to high school. Now U-Jeong is a newbie member of the ping pong club... But in a twist of fate he faces Yeong-Ung again, already an ace player. Can brokenhearted U-Jeong overcome his feelings and go for the win despite the bullies that stand in his way?

(Source: Tappytoon)

147451.description:
“Can I help you? Then get down.”

Sex toy reviewer ‘In-Woo’ who even certifies ejaculation ‘Kang-Won’, the owner of the adult goods shop ‘Hot Bar’ In-Woo’s long-time sex partner and friend ‘Tae-Chan’, a major broadcaster ‘Je-Min’ who is after In-woo. In-Woo gradually falls between three men whose hearts are unknown…

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 12 side story chapters.

147452.description:
After barely waking up from a coma caused by a car accident, Lark is in despair when he learns he can no longer dance. Lark resents Sadin for the car accident and leaves the academy where he danced for years, resolving to start a new live. After a difficult day, Lark's ex-boyfriend Kwai comes to visit him.

But what? The car accident wasn't caused by Sadin?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

147453.description:
Gyeong Gi-Do is the new owner of the "Grand Sauna." How hard can running a sauna be for a talented Wall Street trader?

What Gi-Do doesn't know is that this sauna has been the "gay hot spot" for years. Gi-Do is sick and tired of getting hit on and having to stop customers' indecent behaviors every day.

But one day, Seo I-Rak, an old regular of the sauna shows up, and Gi-Do ends up having a steamy one-night stand in the sauna...

(Source: POCKET COMICS, edited)

147454.description:
A Regent who’s cold on the outside but passionate on the inside x A Chancellor who is unable to be open about his pain and suffering.

The two of them used to be lovers who promised their futures to each other, but they fell victim to the schemes of an evil scoundrel. When they meet again, they are on opposing sides. The Regent is bitter about the past betrayal of the Chancellor, and the Chancellor is being threatened to keep silent about the truth. When the two of them start working together again, the Regent swears to make the Chancellor pay. But beneath the hatred and grudges are two hearts that truly love each other. Will they be able to clear up their misunderstanding and walk towards the future hand-in-hand?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

147456.description:
After the supernatural disaster at Chiyuan Canyon, Xuan Ji, the newly appointed head of the Aftermath Response Division, encounters a demon who was revived by a sinister ritual. As the past and present collide, flames of an ancient war reignite and threaten to topple thousands of years of peace.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

147457.description: The manga tells the story of the Laplace incident, as seen by Neo Zeon soldiers.
synonyms: Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn: The Noble Shroud
Mobile Suit Gundam UC0096 “The Sleeves” Crew Chief Recites a Poem

title.native: 機動戦士ガンダムUC『袖付き』の機付長は詩詠う
title.romaji: Kidou Senshi Gundam UC: Sodetsuki no Kitsukichou wa Utau

147458.description: Aizumi Kyousuke's goal is to debut as a mangaka while still in school, however, his childhood friend, Amane, sees this as an impediment for him to concentrate on his studies now that he started college, so when he asks her for help to be the model of the protagonist of his manga, she will seek to do it "wrong" to take that idea out of his head, not knowing that her "strange" poses would end up motivating him even more.
synonyms: Morisaki Amane is a heroine of this comic.

title.native: このマンガのヒロインは守崎あまねです。
title.romaji: Kono Manga no Heroine wa Morisaki Amane desu.

147459.description: Kijitora is a struggling mangaka who has been without luck in his love life and this fact is affecting his ability to write realistic female characters in his manga. After seeing an advert, he downloads a dating application and ends up nervously going on a date with the enthusiastic Yuuka. Will the date go well? Can he trust this girl?
synonyms: The Romantically Inept Also Wants to Fall in Love Using an App

title.native: 恋愛弱者でもアプリで恋がしたいのだ。
title.romaji: Renai Jakusha demo Appli de Koi ga Shitai no da.

147460.description: A Gundam Memorial from the point of view of Bright Noah, a man who has watched numerous Gundam pilots and Newtypes! What did Bright feel when he saw Amuro, Kamille, and Judau?
synonyms: Mobile Suit Gundam UC: The Man Who Could Not Ride the Rainbow

title.native: 機動戦士ガンダムUC 虹にのれなかった男
title.romaji: Kidou Senshi Gundam UC: Niji ni Norenakatta Otoko

147461.description:
An idol group of cute little animals and... a jaguar?

In a world where animals can live as humans, there exists Marigold, a popular idol group comprised of small, cute animals. Enter Youngwoong, the newest member to be introduced. But with his large hands and piercing eyes, the other members can tell he's different. Could he be… a carnivore?

(Source: Manta)

147467.description:
I'm just a decorative wife... But I love being a waitress during the day and playing with the fluffy pet rabbit at night!

Roseline has been married to King Sieghart Luberia for six months, but she was called the "decorative queen" because she has been untouched for all that time. That was because Sieghart has been cursed, so they couldn't spend the night together! Not knowing that, Roseline doted on the rabbit who came to her bed every night instead. By chance, she also got the chance to work as a waitress at a restaurant in town?!

(Source: FLOS Comic, translated)
synonyms: Since I Became the Decorative Queen, I Decided to Secretly Go to Work
Since I Became a Decoration Queen, I Decided to Go to Work Secretly -I'm Not Lonely Sleeping Alone Because There Is a Rabbit!-

title.native: お飾り王妃になったので、こっそり働きに出ることにしました ～うさぎがいるので独り寝も寂しくありません！～
title.romaji: Okazari Ouhi ni Nattanode, Kossori Hataraki ni Deru Koto ni Shimashita: Usagi ga Iru node Hitori Ne mo Sabishiku Arimasen!

147468.description:
Riri is a transfer student with a unique fascination—she wants the school delinquent, Atsuko, to say adorable things! Despite her fearful reputation, Atsuko goes along with it, thinking Riri is just a harmless weirdo. However, she soon finds herself getting increasingly flustered every time she reads one of Riri's lists of cute words. And she's not the only one whose heart races after each interaction! Will this game bring them closer together and lead to an entirely new relationship?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Started as a self-published web-comic before being picked up for serialization on Web Comic Action on 2021-10-22.
synonyms: スケバンあつ子と転校生神崎
A Delinquent, A Transfer Student, and Their Silly Little Game
スケバンあつ子と転校生神崎

title.english: The Delinquent and the Transfer Student

147470.description:
Nao had a crush on her high school health teacher. Now that she has returned to her old school as a new teacher, her feelings for her now colleague continues to grow! We shouldn't do this in the infirmary...!

(Source: Renai Tengoku, translated)

147471.description:
A story between Franka, Liskarm, Vanilla, and Jessica from Blacksteel WorldWide before they were Rhodes Island Operators.

(Source: Official Site)
synonyms: Rhodes Island’s Records of Originium - Black Steel
ロドス・オリジニウムレコード 黒鋼

title.english: Rhodes Island's Records of Originium - Blacksteel
title.romaji: Luode Dao Yuan Shi Jishi: Hei Gang

147472.description:
One day, a clan tried to destroy the "Ancient Sword," but the mission was failed. To prevent the next catastrophe, Sakuya, the strongest boy of the clan, jumps to the next thousand years, but he finds himself in a world of magic. Sakuya, who cannot use magic, is looked down upon as "incompetent"...!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes 6 extra chapters.

title.romaji: Nana Seiken to Maken no Hime

147473.description: One day, a clan tried to destroy the "Ancient Sword," but the mission was failed. To prevent the next catastrophe, Sakuya, the strongest boy of the clan, jumps to the next thousand years, but he finds himself in a world of magic. Sakuya, who cannot use magic, is looked down upon as "incompetent"...!
synonyms: Seven Holy Swords and the Princess of the Magic Sword

title.romaji: Nana Seiken to Maken no Hime

147474.description: When his boss tells him that the Demon Queen, who offered one of her two hearts to the heroes and sought peace with humanity, has been murdered by a demon tribe that wants to continue the war, Cleto is ordered to take it upon himself to resurrect her. In order to end the war, this simple bureaucrat heads to the territory of the demon tribe with a close associate of the Demon Queen, and the strongest human heroes, who possess the heart necessary to revive her.

title.native: おお魔王、死んでしまうとは何事か　～小役人、魔王復活の旅に出る～
title.romaji: Oo Maou, Shindeshimau to wa Nanigoto ka: Koyakunin, Maou Fukkatsu no Tabi ni Deru

147475.description:
Shizuoka, March 2019. The town where Shiira, a first-year high school student, lives is said that will sink to the bottom of the sea if a major earthquake strikes, but he is fine with that as he still has the past of his mother's death in his mind. Shiira's childhood friend, Anko, has feelings for him and asks him to go to Tokyo with her. One day, however, Shiira meets a woman on a cruise ship, and the wheels of fate begin to move.

(Source: Big Comics, translated)

147476.description: The fantasy story centers on Zabi, who ventures into the outside world Utopie in order to save his kingdom, the last human nation, which is fast running out of land and resources.

147477.description:
Liila gets a job as a servant at castle Aldevaran, which is rumored to be haunted and no doubt has a shady history. The Aldevaran lords have been known as cruel and thirsty for blood for generations. However, the current lord of the castle, Alferdo, is a gentle man. Normally one would think he'd be way beyond Liila's reach, but he looks after her. In time, Liila realizes she's in love with Alferdo, while mysterious and otherworldly things follow one another at the castle…

(Source: K.K. HarperCollins Japan)

147480.description:
The Hakkenshi (Eight Dogs) who appear in the famous Edo period novel Nansou Satomi Hakkenden are brave and handsome warriors who risked their lives to fight for the revival of their family! The Hakkenshi were somehow reincarnated in modern Japan, and under the command of their leader, Fushihime, they decided to form an idol group [STM8]...?

(Source: Betsucomi, translated)

147482.description:
For a hundred years, I waited for you... The moment Kio meets her new company director, Haruomi, she feels a strong aching from within her body. He sweetly seduces her while kissing her neck relentlessly. The days of a neverending piercing sensation, gasping and moaning in pleasure.

While drowning in his love, she recalls the memories of her previous life, “Haruomi” crying while holding “her” dying body. Sharp-blade fangs sticking out from his mouth... Surpassing time, both of them reunite. "I definitely won’t let you go again."

A tenacious love between a vampire and human, revolving around the past and present.

147484.description:
“Time to go to hell!”

Anyone who boards the Hakuko Maru ship is alerted to their destination. It seems to be the only alternative left for those unemployed, bankrupt small traders, landless peasants, poor young people and others rejected by society. Still, no one is prepared for the hell that is the ship's routine. In that mix of boat and factory, on the high seas, workers have no rights and are at the mercy of brutal exploitation and violence from the fishing conglomerate's foremen. Some die from malnutrition, others from mistreatment. The workers then discover that, if they don't want to work themselves to death, they will have to resist and fight for their lives.

A classic of 20th century Japanese literature, an exciting comic book version. Originally published in 1929, the novel Kanikosen cost the life of its author, Takiji Kobayashi. Because of the book's enormous success, Kobayashi aroused the ire of the Japanese government and ruling classes. After living in hiding for some time, the writer was arrested, brutally tortured and, finally, murdered by the police in 1933. He was just 29 years old.

Kanikosen was banned for many years, but was eventually rediscovered and, since then, it has been one of Japan's most cultivated novels, with several versions for cinema, theater and this celebrated manga adaptation by Gō Fujio.
synonyms: 30-pun de Yomeru... Daigakusei no Tame no Manga Kanikousen
30分で読める…大学生のためのマンガ蟹工船

title.native: 純情クレイジーフルーツ続編

147486.description:
Akiyuki, a college student and father, brought his twin daughters Lemon and Mikan to a bathhouse. He was struggling with the children, who were frolicking around the bathhouse for the first time, when a tough-looking man called out. Akiyuki instinctively protected his children, but his twin daughters took to the tough-looking but gentle man immediately...?

(Source: Oakla Shuppan, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: 学生パパとおいしい男

147487.description:
Sherbert is a magical creature from another realm called Lylasia, where different species of magical creatures are locked in a Magical Beast War. Immature and infinitely curious, Sherbert accidentally triggers a portal and ends up in our world. Without any knowledge about our world and our ways, he vows to become a hero here...and battles other magical creatures who make their way across the rift.

(Source: AnimeNewsNetwork)

title.native: 魔法少獣シャーベット

147489.description:
The story of Christina Mackenzie as a test pilot at the Montana Base before she arrived on Side 6 and of one of the Cyclops Team’s previous mission.
Notes:
Volumes 1 contains 3 prequel chapters.
synonyms: Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket

title.native: 機動戦士ガンダム0080 ポケットの中の戦争
title.romaji: Kidou Senshi Gundam 0080: Pocket no Naka no Sensou

147490.description:
Deadly enemies join forces to solve a case.

In Meng Zhao's eyes, Lu Shichen in the past looked like a paper sack wrapped in skin, looking calm from a distance but terrifying up close. So, at that time, everyone was chasing Lu Shichen, but Meng Zhao found him so fake that he hated him. Meng Zhao never expected that one day he would be able to meet Lu Shichen, and even less that he would become the prime suspect in a murder case... And it turns out that the person who is in charge of resolving this case is none other than Detective Meng Zhao.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

147491.description:
Over the years, countless powerful cultivators have come and gone. But the world never realized that behind every powerful cultivator, there seemed to be a mysterious... Dark Crow. After the Dark Crow guided a legion of young cultivators to the peak of cultivation and established their own sects, he chose to leave the world behind.

Thousands of years have passed since his departure, and the once mighty sects have become weak and in danger of failing. Finally the Dark Crow returned in the form of a young man, here to fulfill his promise to defend the sects.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

147492.description:
Company employee Tokiwa lives with his cousin Asagi. The two of them were living their normal, comfortable lives until one day, intoxicated with liquor on the night of Tokiwa's birthday, they began to reveal their deepest secrets...

"The truth is, I remember my past lives."
"The truth is, I'm a time traveler."

A science-fantasy tale in which the fates of a reincarnation and a time traveler are intertwined!

Note: Chapter count includes four extra chapters, an epilogue, and two volume bonus chapters.

147493.description:
The silly zombie Lord who enjoyed peeling garlic fell in love with a dummy-sweet vampire who hates garlic the most. And their biggest habit is lying next to each other in a coffin? This sweet romance will brighten up your world!

(Source: Webnovel)

147494.description:
A cross species, angsty love story that features a beautiful snake demon and a human girl.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: My Husband Is A White Snake

147496.description:
The kid next door came back as an adult. What he is aiming for... is my ♡♡...?!

Choi In-Ho, the kid next door who took care of him when he was young, appears in the basement of this ordinary office worker. Due to In-Ho's fraud (?), he suddenly ends up living in the basement.

In-Ho, who has been in love with the kid since his childhood, tries to seduce him, but fails once and for all..

What do we do to flirt with this dull brother?!

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)
synonyms: So I'm Raising a Tiger Cub

147497.description:
I was a perfectly fine necromancer, so how have I ended up becoming the chief of novice village? But, since it's all set in stone, I'll just build a village that has a harem filled with beautiful young girls! Do you have a problem with that? I didn't think so! Let's begin the parallel world's novice village (harem) from scratch...

(Source: Webnovel)

147498.description:
Saotome is an established author that hasn't published anything in so long that his fans think he's deceased. The reason for his long break is because he's determined that his upcoming release contain a scene where the protagonist tells the object of her affection her feelings...and he just can't bring himself to write it. Enter Sasasori, Saotome's new editor and former high school friend. Sasasori knows Saotome has it in him to include some romance in his stories, since back in the day, he himself was the object of Saotome's affections!

(Source: Animate International)

title.native: 喋らない来栖さん、心の中はスキでいっぱい。
title.romaji: Shaberanai Kurusu-san, Kokoro no Uchi wa Suki de Ippai.

title.native: 隠れオタク女子の日常

147502.description:
Okura is a tough veterinarian who works at Kinako Animal Hospital, right near the entertainment district. One day, a kind and earnest college student named Momo brings in a tiny kitten he found on the streets, and the two men grow closer as Okura helps Momo learn about cat parenthood. It isn't long until their conversations turn from petcare to their experiences with romance as Okura finds himself wanting to get to know Momo better. Will their relationship grow into something more with a kiss?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: คุณหมอคนดีพร้อมเป็นแฟนเสมอ

147503.description:
Joji, an ordinary office worker, got married a month ago. His wife Karen is a Russian girl, beautiful as a fairy, with eye-catching bright silver hair. However, Karen is a busy cartoonist, and they have not been able to do much together as a married couple. Karen's work settles down and they finally have some free time. In order to celebrate their new life together, Joji came up with the idea of... a honeymoon! Having gotten to know each other through travel, they return to their roots and head off on a trip to Niijima Village...!

Let's go on a trip, my lovely wife and I. Enjoy life as a married couple, a romantic comedy about a honeymoon!!!!

(Source: Comic Gamma Plus, translated)

147505.description:
A new maid, Elle, arrives at the mansion of Souta Kanari, a cynical little brat. Elle is a busty, beautiful and mild-mannered girl, but Souta is still scared of her. Because... Elle is over 3 meters tall! On top of that, she acts menacingly only towards Souta. Thinking back on it, Souta realized that he had bullied Elle when they were kids.... What if Elle's goal is to get revenge on Souta?

The big-boned maid will make the twisted little boy understand with her big ass!
This is a slightly naughty comedy about the difference in body size. What will be Souta's fate under this aggressive attack?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)
synonyms: The Giant Maid Puts You in Your Place ♥

147507.description:
Amidst the religious conflicts of 16th century England, facing financial difficulties and extreme turmoil, a young 25-year-old Queen Elizabeth ascended to the throne. Elizabeth had to live like a man in the world of politics under numerous domestic and international threats. Her only emotional support was her love for Robert, whom she had nurtured since childhood... This book depicts the life of the virgin Queen Elizabeth, who led England to become the most powerful country in Europe and vowed to "marry my country and its people"!

(Source: Fairbell, translated)
synonyms: Elisabetta la regina che sposò la patria

title.romaji: Elizabeth: Kuni to Kekkon Shita Joou

147510.description:
Rose became an assassin to survive as an immigrant refugee. Her lover, Benika, is an ordinary schoolgirl, who wanted to keep their homosexual romance hidden from her father, a priest at the church where Rose goes to confess her sins of murder. Rose's employer, the "Organization," is also on the move, as Rose's personal and professional relationships are about to get very, very messy!?!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes one epilogue and five omake chapters.

It’s the age-old story...a high school boy who hates women, who captured the heart of “Koi”… A walking Egyptian mural painting from 3000 BC Cleo-san!!!!? Love comedy!!

147514.description:
A red love letter lies in front of the cafe. The cafe owner is sneakily searching for the person who secretly sent the letter. The culprit is Won-Jun, who always orders a cup of citron tea at the cafe. Won-Jun, caught by the cafe owner, starts to cry. Seong-U gets an erection after seeing Won-Jun's crying face. Won-Jun, have you ever done it with a man? Do you want to sleep with me?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

147515.description:
Choi Gyutae is a French high schooler who comes to Korea as a transfer student. On his first day of class, he meets Lin Seok: a handsome student who just so happens to be in the same class. Lin Seok’s friendly disposition and irresistible charm leads Gyutae to fall head over heads the moment he lays eyes on him. However, on their way back home Seok says something that makes Gyutae lose all hope of the two of them ever dating: “Guys who don’t keep their virginity...should really just go die.” Taken aback by this unrealistic condition for love, Gyutae decides to settle for the two of them remaining platonic for the rest of their lives. Six years later, they’ve become good roommates and even better friends. But when Gyutae witnesses something that shocks him to his core, their relationship might be in danger. Will a misunderstanding cause their friendship to be dead in the water? Or will their relationship be able to survive the competition?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes ten extra chapters.

147519.description:
While trying to hide the fact that he’s an alpha, Hayden is approached by Brett for help on a class project. However, it turns out that Brett is not only a fellow alpha, but one that doesn’t use scent blockers. The two naturally butt heads and continue as a series of unsettling encounters unfold…until Brett takes things one step too far.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: เล่ห์ร้ายนายอัลฟ่า
不愉快の美学〜羊の皮を着た狼〜

147520.description:
A doctor, Gyeong-Hun Min, has an exceptional grudge against Yeong-U Sin, the chairman of a gang called the Crimson Moon. Desperate to take revenge on Yeong-U for killing his wife and daughter, the doctor finally finds Si-Hwan Ryu, a police officer who has supernatural powers that can surpass the currently invincible Yeong-U. Leveraging this, Gyeong-Hun’s plan is to purposely create a reason for Si-Hwan to despise the Crimson Moon and destroy Yeong-U for good. Will his plans succeed? Will Si-Hwan and Gyeong-Hun finally wipe out the Crimson Moon?

(Source: WEBTOON)

147521.description:
I'm Chang-Ju Lee, 26 years old, on the verge of graduating from college, and about to be crushed to death when a building collapses.

It's all because a junior I met in my liberal arts class asked me to go to an exhibition in this building. All my friends told me to avoid him because he's a murderer, but I didn't believe them. From an objective point of view, X is handsome and has a cute personality, so how could he be a murderer?

But... Should I have believed them...?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

147522.description:
U-Jin Cha wants his backpacking trip through Europe to be exciting—and maybe even a little bit spicy! Instead, his hotel reservation gets canceled, and it’s pouring rain. To make matters worse, the only person around to help him is Seung-Hyeok, his year-long crush he’s trying to forget! Despite U-Jin’s initial reluctance, one night as Seung-Hyeok’s roommate turns into another... and another. This definitely isn’t the trip U-Jin had in mind, but he’s starting to wonder, is it really that bad?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 24 side story chapters.

147523.description:
Book rental version.
Manga adaptation of the TV show. From 1958 to 1959, all seven chapters were published by Suzuki Publishing. Kyuji Inoue is in the 1st to 4th chapter (first arc), and Kazuo Murayama is in the 5th to 7th chapter (second arc).

147524.description:
When Yuzuru Sakurai returned to his hometown to sell fertilizer for his company, he runs into his former classmate Sou Nakamichi who’s now working as a farmer. Depressed by his inability as a salesman, Sakurai cheers up and begins to think fondly of his work when Nakamichi comforts him. Even though they weren’t friends in school, the two grow closer, and Sakurai begins to think that they could become great friends. Then suddenly, Nakamichi confesses that he always thought Sakurai was cute?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.romaji: Koi wa Sodatte Ai ni Naru

147525.description:
Yona’s been dreaming of this day for seven years.
It’s his 18th birthday and he can finally sleep with Park Chang-il. What’s with the age restriction, you ask? Well, Chang-il is a neighborhood prostitute that Yona's been following around like a puppy for years, just waiting for this moment. But one look at Yona’s oddly big junk, and Chang-il has decided he needs to charge double for this little pervert. Will Yona, who has a thing for bad boys, finally be able to seal the deal? And will Chang-il treat this as just another business transaction or can Yona actually win him over…?

(Source: Lezhin)

When you’re reunited with a childhood crush years after innocent love first blossoms, it’s best to keep your cool! But what if an irresistible attraction springs up in theplace of sweet memories? Can reality ever be as exciting as cherished fantasies?

Sweet Emotions toys with tender feelings and teases out hot-and-heavy flirtation! Will a slightly older woman show a young man the ropes of romance without wearing him out? And can a solo vacation meant to mend a broken heart turn into pure paradise?

(Source: Project-H)

147535.description:
It all started with a job. When wheelchair-bound Subaru Miyazawa decides to visit the planetarium after finishing its brochure design, he unexpectedly bumps into Togo Awase, the photographer involved in the project. Although he'd admired his work, he never thought he'd see the man himself—or that Togo would go so far as to carry Subaru down the steps to view the starry night sky up close. Subaru could only hope they would meet again...

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

After Staring at the Starry Sky
Après avoir regardé le ciel étoilé

title.native: 星空を見つめたそのあとで
title.romaji: Hoshizora wo Mitsumeta Sono Ato de

147536.description:
Ha-Yoon Gong has just landed a huge gig on a major movie set. He’s forgotten and pushed around, but what he faces on set is nothing compared to the clients he sees as a host at a gay bar. Although Ha-Yoon feels his future is bleak, he powers through. But, working alone one day on set, Ha-Yoon is approached by the star actor, Ian Kwon--the first to use Ha-Yoon’s name and pay him any mind. As the two grow closer, Ha-Yoon starts to believe maybe he does deserve good things.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

147537.description:
During the period of Japanese colonial rule, a young Korean boy, Yong-Hyeon, is invited every summer to a royal residence in the mountains behind his village. The residence of one Count Tachibana. The peculiar Tachibana Sho is a complete mystery, as it seems he’s never left his mansion, not even once. But over the summers, Tachibana Sho and Yong-Hyeon have made a strange but solid bond with each other. Now Yong-Hyeon is devising a plan to help Sho escape his mansion but it won't be easy. Adults with their meddlesome ulterior motives and the giant mansion itself all present challenges to their idea. How will the two boys break free and what will they learn about each other...?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

147539.description:
If he takes this medicine once a day for 7 days, he'll earn 700 million won?!

Eun-Gyu receives a part-time job recommendation from his lifelong friend, Na-Ra. He reluctantly agrees, but when he arrives for work, there's a very dangerous man with questionable morals awaiting him...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

147540.description:
When he woke up after hitting his head, his sex drive had increased 4000-fold⁉ Seigo Hasegawa suddenly acquired incredible sexual prowess. His childhood friend Anzu Yagami, who felt responsible for Seigo, tried to help him (sexually).

(Source: Young Animal, translated)

147542.description:
This intimate manga anthology is about the struggles and triumphs of individuals learning to navigate daily life with a developmental disorder. The comics follow the stories of nine people, including: a junior high dropout finding an alternate path to education; a former "troublesome" child helping kids at a support school; a so-called problem child realizing the beauty of his own unique quirks; and a man falling in love with the world with the help of a new medication. This inspiring volume illustrates their diverse anxieties and finding self-empowerment in a world not quite built with them in mind.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: We Are Adults, Growing Up with Developmental Disorders.
Descubriéndonos despiertos: crecimos con trastornos del desarrollo

title.english: My Brain is Different: Stories of ADHD and Other Developmental Disorders

147545.description:
Seojin can see how compatible he is with people just with a touch. When he brushes hands with Woohyun the number is 0! Having the lowest compatibility, he avoids Woohyun instinctively but this guy just comes closer and closer... It's a game of cat and mouse!

(Source: Lalatoon)

147547.description:
Han Yisu’s proud of himself for winning over Kang Jihyung, the perfect partner. Not only is Jihyung incredibly rich and handsome, he’s also turned gay just for Yisu and Yisu alone. For Jihyung, Yisu’s willing to move in with Kang Jungman, Jihyung’s father and president of Cheonbong Corporations, and be the daughter-in-law that Jungman so seems to want. So just imagine his surprise when Jihyung suddenly brings home a woman and declares her his fiancee. And not just any woman, but Jungman’s mistress from his favorite bar. Enraged, Jungman chases his own son out of his home and vows to cut him off. Meanwhile Yisu, heartbroken and confused, wants to move out, but Jungman insists that Yisu needs to “take my son’s place.” Yisu’s always considered himself tough, but all this family drama is too much even for him… Just what is he to the house of Kang? Son-in-law, daughter-in-law, stepson, or maybe…all of the above?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: โซ่รักตระกูลคัง
江家のイス～ある財閥家の嫁～

147553.description: It is said that there are 10 million people who enjoy fishing as a sport or leisure, and the process is said to have a "peculiar charm." The main character, Tanaka, works for a local bank and is a big fishing fanatic. He is such a fishing fanatic that he calls himself "a lover of the carp." Our story begins when he was invited to go fishing by a group of friends at the local pharmacy. Tanaka's first experience with a fishing rod was such a thrill that he couldn't get fishing out of his mind.

147554.description:
Nowadays, many people suffer from infertility...

This work is an essay manga that describes the true feelings of a person undergoing infertility treatment. The author went through treatment for 3 years until her baby was born.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)
