147555.description:
Saegusa, who retired from idolry when she went to high school, is good-looking and intelligent. She is always cheerful and friendly, and is the most popular person at school.
Takuya, however, knows a certain side of the highbrow Miss Saegusa.
Today, too, a suspicious-looking woman in a dubious disguise appears at the convenience store where he works part-time. She is, in all likelihood, that Saegusa-san...?
synonyms: My classmate Shion Saegusa was idol. but she is unsure of behavior in front of me.

title.native: クラスメイトの元アイドルが、とにかく挙動不審なんです。
title.romaji: Classmate no Moto Idol ga, Tonikaku Kyodou Fushin nan desu.

147556.description:
On the surface, college classmates Min-Jun and So-Dam are complete opposites of each other but they accidently discover that they do share one thing in common: a BDSM fetish! They enter into an unpredictable and secretive relationship where they begin to explore what they truly like and who they really are.

(Source: POCKET COMICS, edited)

title.romaji: Suki na Ko ni Hana wo Keraremashite

synonyms: A Romantic Comedy That Begins with a Dream

147560.description:
Touya, a boy who wants to die, is one day brought to life by a girl called 'Hachi'.

Hachi, who manages the lower branch of a police organization called 'Daihachi', discovers that he has a special ability called 'irregular', and Momoya is forced to explore the underworld...

(Source: Sneaker Bunko, translated)

title.native: イレギュラー・ハウンド いずれ×××になるだろう
title.romaji: Irregular Hound: Izure XXX ni Naru Darou

147561.description:
Dae-Jang Gong, aka Raid Leader, used to be rank one in the world’s first VR RPG game Rou Online, but now he’s trapped in a game called Astrom as an NPC due to the evil scheming of an AI! Now, Dae-Jang must find a way to escape this sick metaverse, but will he be able to outsmart artificial intelligence?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

147562.description:
I am the perfect guy, with a perfect combination of literary and physical abilities, good looks, and a renowned family! I have been confessed to every day, and I am enjoying my high school life. But even I have my own failures, including my first love, which was never fulfilled. But that's no longer an issue for me! I'm going to conquer this failure and fulfil my first love! Or at least, that's how it should have happened!?

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

147567.description:
Victimized by her little sister's trick, Hwa-Yeong heads to the imperial palace to participate in the crown princess selection process. Now she'll have to put up with… six months of palace stay?! No way! As a last resort, Hwa-Yeong tries to do everything wrong to get disqualified and sent home early but instead finds herself in the royals' favor. What's worse, coincidence keeps bringing Shin-Yeong, the Crown Prince, in her way, and now things are becoming more intense and personal for both of them. "You wish to get kicked out now? I'll do everything in my power to see the opposite happen!" Will Hwa-Yeong see her way through these obstacles and return home before six months?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)
synonyms: ข้าต้องไม่ใช่พระชายา!

147568.description:
Sun-Hee is intrigued by the arrival of the indifferent new girl from Seoul and wants to befriend her. Eun-Byeol puts up a cold exterior and ignores Sun-Hee, who attempts to make friends! When the two finally become friends, Sun-Hee soon starts to question her own feelings for Eun-Byeol

(Source: INKR, edited)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

147569.description:
Makoto, who has run away from home, is picked up by Hazuki, a drunkard, and starts living with him. Every day, Hazuki, a free-spirited 30-year-old bachelor who loves alcohol and girls, will poke his nose into Makoto's business. He may be sloven, but he doesn't ask questions, and his willingness to stay by Makoto's side eventually heals his heart. Even though he knows that he can never be someone special to Hazuki, Makoto still falls in love with him... This is a comedic and heart-warming BL between a good-for-nothing adult who loves alcohol and girls and a runaway boy who is not good at being spoiled living together under one roof.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Originally self-published on Pixiv under the title "Katsubou (渇望)", was then licensed by Brite Publishing for serialization.
synonyms: 続・ずるい男に拾われました

title.native: ずるい男に拾われました

147570.description:
In a certain era, in a certain corner of the vast universe, humans have already entered space and established a great empire. In this time period, the concept of "states" does not exist. Instead, private capitals and giant enterprises make up the government, and control every aspect of society. Besides from private property, nothing else is sacred. Dong Zhongmin, whose hometown near the border got destroyed and Chu Ping, who wants to find someplace she can call home after being ruined by her family, journey together far and wide.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

147572.description:
Legendary dragon Ishimi helps Cheonyeong the human emperor gain power, only to be betrayed and get trapped in a cave for 500 years. Then he receives an unexpected visitor, a young prince named Cheonseo who looks exactly like Cheonyeong and takes a liking to Ishimi. Determined to get revenge on Cheonyeong's descendant, Ishimi plans to use Cheonseo's blood to regain his strength. But the more Cheonseo visits him, the more Ishimi grows attached to his only visitor. Which will prevail, the dragon's burning desire for vengeance or his budding affections for the prince who loves him?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

147573.description:
Han Seon-Woo may not be a single mom working two jobs, but he is a struggling student working endlessly to support himself and his family. Disaster strikes during a part-time moving shift when he accidentally shatters an expensive jewelry box belonging to Hee-Jin, the sleek, wealthy CEO of an adult novelties company. Completely unable to afford the damages, Seon-Woo jumps at the chance when Hee-Jin offers an unconventional way to pay off his debt: becoming the company’s official product review model. Seon-Woo expects an embarrassing ordeal, but as the testing sessions get increasingly hands-on, he finds himself unraveling—and getting completely lost in his deepest, hidden desires...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

147574.description:
Alpha Yeon In-Jun and Omega Kwon Se-In fell in love in high school but remained friends. However, that changes when Choi Jae-Kyung steals Se-In away by imprinting on him while In-Jun is studying abroad. But when In-Jun and Jae-Kyung get into a car accident, In-Jun wakes up in the other alpha's body! He slowly learns of Jae-Kyung's schemes to take advantage of Se-In's family connections and does his best to protect his omega. Will In-Jun and Se-In get their happily ever after, or has Jae-Kyung damaged their relationship beyond repair?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra.
synonyms: เมื่อผมกลายเป็นรุ่นพี่

147575.description:
Chen Yuncheng's childhood experience was a nightmare. He didn't expect that sixteen years later, he'll encounter someone who experienced the same thing as him.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

147577.description:
“Do you want to sleep with me?”

Baek Kwon-Young doesn’t like Nam Ju-Ha, no, not at all! But desperate times come for desperate measures especially when Kwon-young’s father announces that he wants Ju-Ha to become part of the Baek family. If Ju-Ha says yes to that proposal, that means Juha’ll basically inherit Ilbi Group, the Baek family’s conglomerate. Kwon-Young has to do anything to stop this from happening. Will Kwon-Young’s fake romance be successful? What will Ju-Ha become? The stepson or the sex partner?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.
synonyms: フェイク・ロマンス〜兄弟なんて困る〜

147580.description:
Eun-Ho Cha is, without a doubt, the biggest outcast at school. He spends his days avoiding bullies and daydreaming about his crush. He’d give anything to be popular, so when he discovers a face editing app called Icing, he spies an opportunity. With Icing’s help, Eun-Ho now looks like a superstar… or at least Ganzi Monster (GM), his online alter ego, does. But just when GM and his dance videos are starting to get popular, someone discovers his secret, and Eun-Ho’s days of being invisible are about to come to an end…

(Source: Tapas, edited)

147581.description:
Meet Sangmok High’s Fox Club, home to the prettiest, wealthiest, and most popular girls in school. To ordinary Onyu Park, whose most extraordinary trait is being best friends with the gorgeous Chaeri Shin, the Foxes exist in a whole other world – or so she thinks – until she and Chaeri are suddenly thrown into the Fox Club headfirst! As if adjusting to high school wasn’t hard enough, the girls find themselves surrounded by prying eyes, rumors, catty schemes, and budding romance. Will Onyu and Chaeri’s friendship survive all of the drama and secrets? Who are the Foxes, really? And does Onyu have what it takes to become one of them?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Woo-Bin is an expert at seducing rich ladies with his handsome looks, and lives off of the gifts he receives from them. He approaches the rich, beautiful Su-Ji to prey on her... but ends up falling in love! Blinded by love, Woo-Bin doesn't realize that Su-Ji isn't the angel he thought she was, but rather has a dark side that slowly entangles him. Each with clearly different intentions, Woo-Bin and Su-Ji fall into a romance that can't be recycled!

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

title.english: Trash Belongs in the Trash Can!

147586.description:
On the outside, Ailette Rodeline is an adorable child prodigy. Cooking, brewing tea, alchemy; you name it, she can do it. But this little girl has a big secret: Ailette is a transmigrator! After dying prematurely in her past life, she becomes a character whose world is destined for destruction. With all odds stacked against her, Ailette must figure out how to survive before her life is ripped from her again. Fortunately for her, she finds her salvation in… an insurance package?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Preferential Treatment for the Possessed Person
สิทธิพิเศษของผู้สวมร่าง

title.english: The Perks of Being an S-Class Heroine

147587.description:
Bianca de Arno was a ruthless countess in the Kingdom of Sevran, infamous for being a wicked and selfish wife. While her husband, Count Zachary de Arno, bravely risked his life out on the battlefield, she sat at home and spent his money. It wasn’t until her final day that Bianca realized the error of her ways. Before she dies, Bianca prays for a second chance, swearing she will do better, and wakes up in her 19-year-old body. With her second chance, Bianca starts to see everything in a new light… starting with her husband.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 46 extra chapters.

147589.description:
The No. 1 ranker “Agaya,” the first player who reached the maximum level in the game, ‘Dungeon Story’, is in despair because his experience stats are no longer increasing. No matter which bizarre moves Agaya tries, the game quests seem too easy. Finally, Agaya thinks of a solution.

I will start playing the game from scratch using another account, imitating a Newbie!

Will Agaya be able to enjoy the game without others finding out who he is?

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)
synonyms: Leveling Again: The Story of Agaya

147590.description:
The journey of a very sweet, fluffy, and warm couple! The author, Da Ning, wrote about the 10 years of her relationship with her lover, Lin Zhiyi, in a light, humorous way. The two fell in love at first sight on the university campus. Time and distance tested their relationship, but it only made their love stronger, as they built their life together with love. "No matter how big the world may be, the only view that matters to me, is you."

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes the prologue

My World is Complete Because of You

147591.description:
Republic of Korea Special Forces, Kang Yi-Chan. During the mission, he faced enemies to save his comrades and was isolated alone in the operational area of the mission. It had been several days since he had faced the enemy without being able to sleep and waiting for rescue to come for him… but in the end, he saw the bazooka flying over the hill, he realized that it was the end of his life and then fainted… When he regained consciousness and opened his eyes, he found himself in a trance, alone in a strange world.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

147592.description:
When noblewoman Cecilia realizes she’s been reincarnated into an otome game, her shock is further complicated by the fact that she’s the villainess! What’s worse, she can’t seem to change her fate. Now, her engagement is broken off, the heroine is harassing her, and she’s forced to work in a brothel—where her very first customer turns out to be the debauched Leader of the Imperial Guard, Lucas Herbst. This dangerous Casanova looks like he’ll be the end of her, until he takes her as a fiancée!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: The Villainess and the Demon Knight

147593.description:
Being reincarnated as an otome game villainess is hard enough, but fate sure didn’t hold back on stacking the odds against Cecilia. Her engagement is broken off, the heroine is harassing her, and she’s forced to work in a brothel! To make matters worse, her first customer is none other than the heroine’s childhood friend and debauched leader of the Imperial Guard, Duke Lucas Herbst. Terrified, Cecilia shares an intense night with him, only to wake up the next day in his mansion—marked as his fiancée?! Bound to this unhinged knight, the troubled villainess must endure his obsessive love. But is his intoxicating affection a curse…or is it a blessing in disguise?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: The Villainess and the Demon Knight

147594.description:
A millennium ago, the Blue Moon Kingdom was engulfed in an endless war due to internal conflicts. On the verge of total destruction, the Kingdom was saved by the hands of a masked hero called the 'Red Man'. The survivors exiled the militants who started the rebellion and established the "Blue Moon City", a magnificent civilized paradise led by a large corporation.
Unfortunately, for an elementary school teacher, Mr Kim, being the descendant of the infamous tyrants meant living in the impoverished slums. Although he had nothing to his name, he held his students very close to his heart. But his life took a turn for the worst when his beloved students got kidnapped. As he took his last breath after getting shot by a gunman for attempting to save the kids, the principal of his school handed him a mask which gave him special powers. Kim, resurrected as the incarnation of insatiable, anger sets out to take revenge on the people who ruined his happy life. "I will bring my students back." Criminals beware. A teacher is coming after you to teach you regret and pain.

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)

147595.description:
Based on the novel by the literary master, Ango Sakaguchi, this story is set in a certain year in the Meiji Period. There are rumors of a famous detective who solves difficult cases, one after another, that even the police are unable to solve. His name is Yuki Shinjuuro, and together with his partner, Inga Hananoya, he faces bizarre cases that occur in this civilized world. A Romantic mystery depicting a brilliant gentleman detective's deductions and the darkness inside the hearts of people living in this glamorous age!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

147596.description:
Agematsu Yuuta is the author of the most popular web novel of the century—and he’s only in high school! With such a huge hit under his name, he finds himself the target of affection from people like a beautiful editor, an idol singer, and a popular voice actor! However, Yuuta’s main goal is to win over his childhood friend through a heartfelt confession...and things take a very unexpected turn!

A rom-com about cute girls competing for a best-selling author.

(Source: Manga UP!)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

“It would have been better to just forget about it.”

Despite his best efforts, Hyun-Goo is transferred to a local area and returns home. He runs into his high school classmate Moon Sang, who runs the bookstore Jeong-Mun Bookstore, which he used as his hideout, after 10 years, and his heart starts pounding again as memories of their first kiss that he tried hard to bury...

147604.description:
Siwoo is a member of the idol group Space Age but is aspiring to become an actor. His acting career gets off to a rocky start but when he gets an offer from a powerful (and handsome) executive to keep his career going, this is a deal he can’t refuse...

(Source: Lezhin US)

147605.description:
"Soohyun’s not your average college student, considering his unfortunate circumstances. He’s always had bad luck, but even he didn’t expect to be sold off to and locked up at a secret, exclusive sex club where he’s used mercilessly by the clients against his will… It hasn’t always been like this for Soohyun. There was a time, long ago, when he was in love with a boy who was gentle and kind and loved by everyone… But little does Soohyun know, his past and present aren’t as separate as he thinks. When he runs into someone familiar at the club, all those memories are going to resurface in a whirlwind and riptide of emotions, and his past and present are going to come together…

(Source: Lezhin US)

147606.description:
It’s all rainy days for Ban Dong-Wook. Haunted by ghosts, he is unable to fall asleep no matter what he does. But one night, with Lee Do-Hyun by his side, he is able to clear his mind and drift off into dreamworld. Dong-Wook is convinced he needs Do-Hyun, but the latter is scared to love him in return. Will the two be able to work through the storm and find sunny days ahead? Or is the hurricane that is love destined to tear them apart?

(Source: Lezhin US)

147608.description:
Seungjun works part-time singing congratulatory songs at weddings, and Jaehyun quit his job to work as an emcee for a wedding hall. The two end up crossing paths by chance. Will the talkative and personable Jaehyun be able to ruffle the feathers of the usually calm and collected Seungjun?

(Source: Lezhin)

147611.description:
Do-Hyeon is not a very noticeable guy on campus. Seung-Ju, his junior, happens to become close with Do-Hyeon by doing group projects together. But then Seung-Ju starts becoming curious about Do-Hyeon, who for some odd reason is blunt only with him.

In fact, Do-Hyeon has a secret crush on Seung-Ju, and his feelings are growing...

Young Pal-Jae drifts to the isle at world's end to be taken in by Mun-Ryeong, a hermit with a mysterious past. But when Pal-Jae begins to waste away in the sun-bathed climate, Mun-Ryeong takes his little companion on a journey to the cold north that uncovers their forgotten past encounter.

Lumiére's just moved in with his owner and wonders why Lluvia, the cat next door, won't have anything to do with him. Will Lluvia ever come around? A gentle tale of becoming friends, and perhaps something more.

I open my eyes one day and find myself lying on a huge bed in a room I've never seen before. "What am I doing here!?" Just as I think that, a bunch of handsome demons show up, as if they stepped straight out of a fantasy!!! "...I want you to kiss me, and be at ease," says the mighty, manly Demon King. "Please... Hurry, I want it...!" says the attractive middle-aged prime minister. "Ah!! No! If you touch both those places at once... Aahn!!" says the hot young instructor. Time to say goodbye to my boring former existence, and become... the strongest and sexiest evil god!? The story of a wide-eyed, ordinary businessman's reincarnation into a parallel universe with a hot, demonic, homoerotic reverse harem begins!!

147625.description:
500 years ago, Chase Elkin sealed the Dragon of Chaos, Kelgrave, and became immortal. Now living a leisurely life, his world is turned upside down when the dragon-cursed Emperor Cyril appears before him. Smitten at first sight by Cyril’s striking beauty, Chase is determined to help break the curse. Together, they embark on a perilous journey to the imperial palace.
But there’s a twist! To prevent the curse from progressing, Chase must continue to kiss Cyril, leading to many awkward yet tender moments. What adventures will this bashful warrior and the handsome, irritable emperor face as they navigate their way to the imperial palace?

Amidst blushes and stolen glances, Chase’s feelings for Cyril grow stronger. Their journey is filled with magical challenges, dark forces, and the constant need to stay close, which is both a blessing and a curse. Will their budding romance survive the dangers ahead?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jung Taeyoon, a member of a popular K-pop idol group, is stepping into the world of acting after six years since his debut. Lee Seojun could only watch as his daughter, the witch Lee Seola, turned into the wicked final boss who destroyed the world and brought upon his death. Though never a good dad, as he loses consciousness, Seojun gets a new quest: “Change The Future.” Upon awakening, he sees a 5-year-old Seola standing before him. Now, Seojun must raise Seola to avoid the misfortunes that originally turned her wicked and become the caring father she never had. The price of failure? Only the end of the world.

(Source: Tapas)

A trap lying on the internet…
An outcome exceeding expectations…
This can't be dismissed as being irrelevant to you!

Kyouichirou Oike is a senior high schooler who’s most recognizable traits are his slowness and laziness. However, he has another identity: a genius kid who solves the most mysterious and perplexing cases! As he develops a newfound relationship with his bubbly, bold classmate Kotomi Otokuni, due to her meddlin, he gets sucked into the case…

Can Kyouichirou save Otokuni, who’s unable to understand the predicament she’s in?!

Kikka, who works as a "wasai" (traditional Japanese clothing manufacturer) at home, is a job given by Mashimo, her ex-boyfriend from high school. One day Kikka was selected to be a board member of the apartment complex lives at and met with a man named Hirara...!? Mashimo lives 200 meters away from Kikka's house and Hirara lives 200m above. The vertical and horizontal romance triangle has begun!

147646.description:
Tsubame Sakamoto is a single woman, 25 years old. She finds relief from the daily stress of life by indulging in food and drink at baseball games, trying out the variety of offerings at different stadiums, with the crowd loudly cheering around her. It might be a little pricey, but nothing tastes better than a cold beer after a win. Freed from the pressure of society, she can truly enjoy the best of stadium food!

Gyu-Jin is special. He’s the only son of the legendary blue-eyed German shepherd family…and he’s a 26-year-old virgin. To carry on the family lineage, his parents organize an arranged marriage. However, Gyu-Jin cannot think of getting married to a stranger, let alone a female shepherd. He impulsively decides to ruin his parents’ scheming by preemptively announcing that he prefers smaller dogs. In order to cover up his lie, Gyu-Jin asks his childhood friend Young-Woon, a small breed, to act as his boyfriend in front of his parents. Young-Woon agrees under one condition: Gyu-Jin must act like he really has feelings for him! With such a strange demand, could Gyu-Jin be barking up the wrong tree?

On impulse, he grabs Hyeon-U’s shirt, and shamelessly asks his number and the man… actually gave it. Like a reckless teenager, he dives into this chance at romance with Hyeon-U. But, unlike ordinary relationships, he’ll find that beneath this sweet encounter, lies something deeply twisted.

On the tails of Yoonhu’s latest breakup, Bambi begins to visit him every night in the form of special dreams. But the attraction is unexpectedly irresistible, and things get convoluted when dreams become better than reality. Everything has always been clear cut and by-the-books for this clever incubus, but will everything go according to plan this time around?

But as an alien to whom earth laws technically do not apply, he’s been hard at work in a top-secret capacity: government-sanctioned extrajudicial assassin, cleaning up the worst of society that the law is either too slow or too powerless to confront. After years of dispatching hapless crime lords and their goons, things have gotten comfortable. But Rocopon is about to meet his match in more ways than one—fed up with his sloppy ways, headquarters has assigned him a straight-laced partner, and the criminal underground has enlisted the help of those who are a little more than human…

After inheriting their grandfather’s beloved used bookstore, the Karakida sisters move to the neighborhood to carry on his legacy. Surrounded by the comforting scent of old books, the three sisters begin building a quiet life together—turning each day into a new page in their story.

He tags along Sarang wherever he goes, just like a puppy would its owner. But as Eden grows older, he realizes his feelings for Sarang were far more than just brotherly love. Unable to suppress his feelings any further, Eden ends up kissing Sarang on a live internet channel when he's drunk. The dynamics between the two change, and Eden becomes bolder, making sure Sarang knows how he feels. Will Sarang reciprocate his love? After awakening in a webnovel as Princess Clara, this former office worker isn’t getting the royal treatment. As the shy sister of the tyrannical King Bastian, she’s immediately faced with disdain and so much drama! Plus her character's destined to be seduced by his latest hostage, Crown Prince Daniel, accused of betrayal, and executed. But Clara’s got a backbone and a plan to win over her brother. 147755.description:
There are two kinds of people in this world. The aristocracy, winners from birth, and the rest of the losers, the cattle. Owen Pepper is the heir of a Noble family.
"I am a winner, of course. Bwahahaha. Livestock, you can work hard for me today. It is the only thing you lot are good for! I have been reincarnated as a trash aristocrat."
His father was a villainous lord. And Owen has been deeply influenced by his father and has grown up to be a fat, incompetent boy!
"If this continues, my future is in jeopardy. … But I do not care about that! I heard that there is magic in this world. If we are going to go to all this trouble, let us try to master magic!”
And if you are having fun learning magic, you will soon be able to break the stigma!

147759.description:
Master swordsman, sage, dragon knight... Remille can’t believe his ears when the princess lists off his possible futures. Born to a lesser noble house, he’s never been anything but a low-level adventurer. In fact, he’s lived that same life seven times—always forming an adventuring party with his friends at age fifteen, and always giving his own life to save theirs three years later. But not this time. The eighth loop is going to be different. After his most recent death reveals his friends’ treachery, Remille finally takes a different path that leads him to Princess Ciel, wielder of the powerful Eye of Appraisal that can judge anyone’s true potential. Will her wild claims about Remille’s future come to pass? With her guidance, can he really become a great sage or a rider of dragons? Is the adorable catlike familiar he’s tamed in past lives really a mighty behemoth, the strongest of the magical beasts? And will he really be able to escape the deadly destiny that’s claimed his life seven times already...?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: 8th Loop for the Win! With Seven Lives' Worth of XP and the Third Princess's Appraisal Skill, My Behemoth and I Are Unstoppable!

147760.description:
This is a story about Remille, an adventurer who died. Specifically, he's died a lot—seven times now, always at the hands of vicious monsters. Every time, though, he's returned to the same day, three years prior. He's tried everything at this point, from sword fighting to magical arts to beast taming, but it always ends the same way. Is there any hope for him in this 8th loop of his life?

Perhaps a chance encounter with Princess Ciel might change things? Her magical eye can see all possible futures—and with Remille's vast stores of XP from seven lives of adventuring, just about anything is possible! Add in the fact that his erstwhile feline friend Catra isn't exactly what she seems (and how the princess herself wants to party up with him) and this 8th loop might just be the charm!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Otaku culture has finally become mainstream, and Megumi can't quite get used to it. Divorced, with a teen daughter, Megumi thinks fondly back to her days as an anime and manga otaku—in 1995. That year, she transferred to a new school and decided to start fresh by hiding her otaku interests. She found herself taken under the wing of a basketball ace named Masamune, who's got a kind heart and looks just like one of her favorite characters. But, though Megumi catches a whiff of destiny in the air, she's crushed to learn that Masamune detests otaku...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

The more time they spent with each other, the more Miyanari recognized Hashiba's kindness, so different from his delinquent image...?

147778.description:
For Sandy the maid, seeing Killian Winifred's handsome face is the best part of working for the Winifred family. But Killian's fiancee, Alexandra, hates his womanizing ways and would rather be struck by lightning than marry him. As if to answer her prayer, lightning strikes Alexandra's carriage while she's out on a rainy day. In that exact moment, Sandy falls off a cliff while gathering mushrooms, landing on the carriage. Next thing she knows, she's waking up in Alexandra's body! With her own body buried in a cemetery, Sandy has no choice but to pretend she's Alexandra. But despite her best efforts, Killian starts noticing changes in "Alexandra's" behavior. The situation get even messier when the real Alexandra's soul shows up and demands her body back. Can Sandy and Alexandra return to their previous lives, or will they have a better chance of getting struck by lightning again?

(Source: NETCOMICS)

Akari Kajino is in his second year at his first job, and he's already sick and tired of the daily grind.
It feels as if he's simply repeating the same day over and over again, and he wonders if this is what he really wants to do with his life.

She can't admit to him that she is the wolf and in her attempt to cover it up, she somehow ended up volunteering to help him look for the wolf instead?!

I know those close to me will betray me, and I remember what turns me wicked. If I can just lift my mother’s curse and master my powers, maybe I can turn my life around. Open plotting and hidden conspiracies combine to fog the truth… As he finds out his true heritage, the mystery is gradually revealed. He wants to grow stronger, but to do that he must pay a heavy price, and overcome challenges no ordinary man can stand. See how an ordinary boy set out on the road to revenge and shakes the world's foundations!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

147881.description:
My situation: a 23-year-old NEET with half a year of work experience.

I was spending my days freeloading at my friend Katsun's place, when I came across a blog that described how to control one's dreams. I could have any dream that I want, as long as I do not die or stay longer than a week in it. In my dream, I found my former classmate Sayaka Kirisaki, a transfer student from 10 years ago. She was my first love, who died in a traffic accident.

As I interacted with her, my life that had ground to a halt began to move forward once more―.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

The humble house-slave Fang Han traveled the world to build up his own strength, forging his ordinary flesh into an immortal body. Now he will step into the immortal realm and claim his rightful place on top of the throne!

“Bye, Yongsu... It’s going to be hard, but please carry on... I really loved you...” Yongsu was dumped today by his girlfriend. And the burden she left is far too big... of a debt. Unfortunate credit delinquent Yongsu is now forced to live each day to the fullest. Every day is a struggle for him to pay up. And he meets various people along the way. His today comes and goes, just like everyone’s todays.

U-Yeong gets scolded by her friends every day because of her sloppy and careless personality. She steals one thing a day and has never done anything properly in her life.

[I will never steal anything again]

I've been stealing stuff like this my whole life, but this is the first time I've ever been caught!

U-Yeong is dizzy from a disgrace she has never experienced before. To make matters worse, her classmate Seo Ju-Hong finds out about it...

Sangil’s high school sweetheart and first love is eager to follow in the footsteps of his father, a professor at a prestigious university. So much so that he gives in to his family and marries, leaving Sangil heartbroken and scarred for years to come. Today, Sangil himself is a professor of Korean Literature who has recently become entangled with a pushy student named Haneul. Sangil finds the relationship entertaining enough at first, but begins developing feelings for Haneul as time goes by. It’s at this moment that Sangil’s first love re-enters his life asking for a second chance.

(Source: Tappytoon)

147897.description:
Lin Mu grew up with his sister, Lin Chao, who is congenitally deaf. He is the "little sun" that illuminates the lives of those around him. Meanwhile, the tall and handsome Lu Rong lost both his parents at a tender age and had since been living with his grandmother who has Alzheimer's disease. He was forced to grow up quickly at an age when he should have been ignorant and oblivious.

Kunqian, an institution that provides learning opportunities for the special community, is where their worlds collide. One a silent soul, and the other a blazing firecracker. With a bunch of schoolmates—a deaf-mute, a visually impaired person, a cerebral palsy patient—they embark together on their chapter of youth.

"Lu Rong, you don't have to put your guard up around me as if I'm some kind of a thief. I have a sister. I get it."
"Okay."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Lorraine, the daughter of an ordinary aristocrat, has maintained one hobby from her past life: fangirling over handsome idols! Plus, it seems like everyone in this new world is drop-dead gorgeous!

One day, Jeremiah, the handsomest one of them all, asks her to pretend to be his lover. Of course, Lorraine was going to refuse, but she is completely overwhelmed by his beauty and aura up close... Weak at the knees, Lorraine accepts his request!

After all, she's just his fan, right? A dreamy romantic comedy about a girl who loves handsome idol men!

Our protagonist is an overeager, idol-loving girl who was reborn as the daughter of a noble family. As an aristocrat, she attended all sorts balls and other events, but she was more interested in watching the handsome men than socializing, dancing, or looking for a marriage partner. Of course, she was just admiring them like she did when she was watching idols in her previous life, and she had no intention of getting involved with the handsome men she admired. But one day, her favorite "object of admiration," the son of a marquis, asked her to play the role of a lover for the sake of convenience.

"Uh, you're too close! This is not good for my heart.....!"

She could have just watched from afar. Now she's going to get an eyeful up close!

Class is in Session!

As classic fantasy creatures start making their home in our modern world, one school welcomes all kinds of races, and it gets a little rowdy when mating season hits! With tail-wagging dog girls looking for some heavy petting, angels and demons with heavenly racks smothering their target in devilish delight and blossoming succubi using their newly acquired powers to suck the love from their beloved’s body, every class’s curriculum aims to stimulate both the mind and body!

Interspecies Love 101 by Awayume is a sugary-sweet look into the love lives of monster girls as their ears perk and wings flutter with amouration. As childhood friendships blossom into life-defining romances, Awayume’s characters beam with fanged smiles and curvy frames as they straddle and envelop their darling. Jam-packed at twelve loving chapters, Interspecies Love 101 is a lesson readers should never skip!

Spring Flings Bloom Romance!

The benefit of being in a relationship with a real wife-guy or girlfriend worshiper is that these women always know they'll be satisfied! Being a little headstrong and a bit of a tsundere, once their partner gets to work on their beautiful and naughty bodies, their faces flush red as they convulse in pleasure. Working over every inch of their sun-kissed bodies from their gaping mouths to their perky nipples, these guys know every little trick in the book to make them swoon. The best part is that once the long night of love-making is over, they can do it all again tomorrow!

Okinaga Umanosuke promises that in their newest release, Spring Yearning, and how there's a little something for everyone to get off to! Featuring six lovely and striking ladies in eight bewitching chapters, readers will love them more with each new page as they are teased and toyed to climax! 147917.description:
Just because you’re old doesn’t mean you can’t throw hands!

Octogenarian Kaichi Takemura is a master of aiki-jutsu, a martial art that specializes in redirecting physical force.

Alas, time soon catches up with the spry old man, as do the perils of an aging body. With a terminal cancer diagnosis and only two months left to live, Kaichi stares out from the hospital with nothing to do but wait for the end of an unfulfilling life... Until the moment he coughs, blinks, and finds himself transported across dimensions along with his resident nurse!

This strange new realm of vicious beasts, experience points, and "skills" is confusing at first, but as he soon finds his body regaining its strength... He realizes it might be just what the doctor ordered!

Thus begins Kaichi’s turbulent, monster-tossing, death-defying adventure in another world!
(Source: Kaiten Books)

147918.description:
Yuma dreams of becoming a mangaka, but her life isn't her own. Bound to a wheelchair, she lives under the suffocating control of her mother, who makes every single decision for her. To make matters worse, her childhood "friend" is exploiting her talent, forcing Yuma to secretly draw a manga for her.
Worn down by the constant abuse, Yuma makes a desperate bid for freedom and applies to an erotic manga magazine. But her meeting with the editor-in-chief is a blunt wake-up call. The editor's advice? If Yuma wants to draw compelling stories, she first needs to gain more... experience.
In every sense of the word. Thus begins Yuma's journey of liberation, one that will take her far beyond the limits she ever thought possible.

Komamoto Kyota is a high school boy who dotes on his 3-year-old sister. His parents both work, so he handles all the housework and childcare at home. Akiyama Sumi is a beautiful, smart, but solitary girl whose intimidating presence keeps everyone at arm's length. When Kyota went to his sister's kindergarten entrance ceremony, he found Sumi there with flushed cheeks, snapping pictures like a pro photographer. "Gosh, how adorable...... she is!" They became friends and gradually grew closer as they learned that they are both taking care of younger siblings. They cook together, help each other pick up the kids from kindergarten, and go on holiday outings. Yes, their relationship is truly that of "mommy's friend." A romantic comedy about child-raising!

147927.description:
In lands barren and bare, tradition called for villagers to offer a bride to the cruel sun god… Here enters our bride: Luca, the gentle son of the late village chief, who is one day struck with fevers, fainting spells, and something more. The villagers understand this as a sign, and the young man, his fear held within his mortal heart, understands it as his assignment. He is to be given over to a ravenous god, who in turn, shall bring bountiful harvests to his neighbors. The one Luca encounters, however, may be far warmer, far more precious than the legends foretold, if only fate would steer them from tragedy…

With more and more martial arts experts rising to the challenge, the entire martial world is about to plunge into bloodshed. Regardless of the imperial court, or the cult, or factions of the martial arts world, all of them only have one goal: To take control of the Black Tortoise Order and find the treasure hidden in the Secret Realm of the Black Tortoise.

Banished from the celestial realm for interfering in the fate of a mortal, Ju-Hee now lives a mortal life herself as the owner of a bookstore. When she suddenly receives an eviction notice, she visits her landlord to plead her case. But what will she do when he makes her a peculiar offer?

(Source: Manta)

147952.description:
With her family deep in debt, Hedel Argetnta was looking for any way out of her disastrous situation. Her only option? Marrying the wealthy but monstrous duke of the east, Cassian Ekarde, a total stranger. Upon her arrival in the East, she learns it is a cursed land infested with criminals, and that her new home is full of dangerous servants. Determined to turn things around, Hedel starts to make changes but finds out that the cause of all this mess might be none other than the man she married.

(Source: Tapas)

147953.description:
When Erina gets adopted by Marquess Sinor because of her magic abilities, she didn't realize her life was only about to get much worse. After years of abuse and torment from the Marquess, Erina is on the verge of breaking down. Just when she decides to end it all, Erina is visited by her past self: Marystella, the powerful witch who once ruled the entire kingdom. No more suffering, no more pain; Erina is about to do whatever she pleases with her newfound power!

147962.description:
In a world where gates suddenly appeared, Espers were like a national power. South Korea's representative S-Class Esper, Cha Jae-U, had a problem: after he gained his powers, he couldn't find a guide who had a high match rate with him.

Thus, it was mandated that all citizens must take the guide test.

"No way... I really hope this is not the case, but..."
"Haa..."
"...Is it Cha Jae-U?"

Hae-Yul took the test, thinking he might as well get it over with, and he set a record of an unprecedented 97.8% match rate with Cha Jae-U!

"So what? I'm a D-Class...!"

Cha Jae-U was an S-Class Esper who had never received proper guiding before and was on the verge of exploding, while Hae-Yul was a pathetic D-Class Guide. Wouldn't even something like going after a boss monster as soon as you select your character be a better choice than that? Hae-Yul was about to refuse, having lost all energy at the thought that he might die, but...

"If a guide for Esper Cha Jae-U doesn't appear, then he will be killed."
'...A-Are they insane?'

Just who was he worrying about, when he might die if he accepted? But after hearing that if he didn't become Cha Jae-U's guide, the Esper would die, Hae-Yul swallowed his tears and signed the contract.

"Um... I already did today's amount this morning..."
"That's it?"
"That's the best I can do..."

Afterward, Hae-Yul lived in one house with Cha Jae-U and a particle-sized amount of mana. He ended up guiding him once a day, but...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: This is a promotional one-shot for a web novel of the same name.
synonyms: A Survival Guide for D-Class Guides

147987.description:
When she was 10, Toaki was friend with a weird girl named Kilala, they played together with Kilala's creepy dolls, one of them looking exactly like Toaki's deceased mother. But because of Toaki's fault, Kilala died to a fall from a tree.

Now in high-school, Toaki meets with a boy of her age named Wataru and his little sister Kokoro ; somehow, they are in possession of some of the dolls that Kilala owned. Meanwhile, Toaki also see Kilala here and there, and she is still 10!

147988.description:
Ryouran High School is a private arts academy full of geniuses in every field-music, dance, fashion. But in reality, it's looks, not talent, that decide its students' success. My sister, Shika Ikebukuro, is a shut-in who can't do anything without her older brother, and I was sure that devastating lack of charisma would doom her. But I know a secret. Behind her mask, the internet sensation VSINGER is none other than my sister Shika! Her voice is one-of-a-kind, but will it be enough to overcome Ryouran High's entire social order?

(Source: Yen Press)

147995.description:
Years after the fall of the Galactic Empire, a solitary bounty hunter is given a simple mission. Find and return the Child to the Imperial Remnant, all that remains of the once all-powerful Empire. This mysterious orphan has a power that can possibly turn events in their favor, and acquisition of that power is paramount. Instead, the bounty hunter goes on the run with the Child to protect him from the forces that would do him harm. Here is the story of The Mandalorian, and his desperate quest to save the Child and himself.

Based on the series created by Jon Favreau and written by Jon Favreau, Dave Filoni, Christopher Yost, and Rick Famuyiwa.

(Source: VIZ Media)

147997.description:
Suzuki’s a high school girl in love, but the guy she’s fallen for is nothing like her! While she’s cheerful, outgoing, and always trying to fit in, her classmate Yusuke Tani is stoic, quiet, and doesn’t seem to care what people think of him. Will Suzuki be able to overcome her anxieties and ask him out, or will she discover that opposites really don’t attract?

(Source: VIZ Media)

Notes:
- Includes 12 extra chapters.
- Placed second in the Tsugimanga 2022 Award in the Web Manga Category.
- Placed third in the 16th Manga Taishou Award and seventh in the 17th Manga Taishou Award in 2023-2024.
